+"""Config of the fused Gated DeltaNet VERIFY step kernel (``gdn_verify_fused_f16.py``): the fixed model geometry it serves, the
+compile-time knobs of its one kernel body and the shared-memory budget per tokens-per-request count.  Importable without the
+CuTe DSL (the host entry validates a ``Cfg`` before the DSL version gate runs), so nothing here imports ``cutlass``.
+
+Geometry (the Qwen 3.5-architecture dense 27B GDN sub-layer at tensor-parallel rank 1, the same as the fused decode step's): 16 K heads,
+48 V heads (three per K head), head dim 128, causal-conv width 4, hidden 5120; the QKV slab is ``[rows, 10240]`` = Q (16 x 128) | K
+(16 x 128) | V (48 x 128); the fp32 recurrent state is ``[slots, 48, 128, 128]`` (one 64 KB slab per V head); the conv history of a
+verify slot holds ``T + 2`` columns of 10240 channels, stored channel-contiguous (``[slots, T + 2, 10240]`` viewed ``[slots, 10240, T + 2]``).
+
+The verify step: a request of ``T`` tokens (``T`` = the second extent of the slot-index table, a compile-time constant of the
+kernel: tokens per request of the serving plan) starts from the state of its last accepted token (slot ``indices[n, a - 1]``,
+``a = num_accepted_tokens[n]``) and writes the state after every token ``t`` to slot ``indices[n, t]`` (a slot ``<= 0`` skips
+that write).  One CTA per (request, V head), 256 threads = two warpgroups; the ``T`` tokens run sequentially on the
+register-resident (or shared-memory-resident) state rows; every token's updated slab goes out by ``cp.async.bulk`` stores
+from a ring of padded shared-memory boxes.
+
+Default (``default_cfg``; the host entry's pick when the caller passes no ``Cfg``): while every CTA of the ``requests x 96`` cluster
+grid has an SM of its own (``requests * 96 <= SM count``: one request on a 148- / 152-SM part) the two-CTAs-per-head PAIR form
+``PAIR_CFG`` serves (``TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD``: each CTA of a cluster pair owns half the state rows, so every per-SM term -- the 32 KB slab in,
+the 32 KB write-back per token, the register-resident rows, the pass math, the straight-line code -- halves, which is what the cold-L2
+serving regime pays for: every layer's launch finds its code and data evicted); ``ROLLED_TOKENS`` is ON in ``PAIR_CFG`` and in ``CFG``
+(with the L2 swept before every launch the rolled forms are the fastest at one and at two requests on a cc 10.0 part; warm, with the
+code resident, the unrolled pair is marginally faster at one request -- the cold figure decides); while every CTA of the ``requests x
+48`` grid has an SM of its own (``requests * 48 <= SM count``) the one-CTA-per-SM form ``CFG`` serves (TPR 4, the 3-deep ring); past that
+the two-CTAs-per-SM form ``TWO_CTA_CFG`` serves (the register-capped form that lets two CTAs share an SM so the grid runs in one wave).
+Every form is bitwise with the reference kernel -- FlashInfer's built-in ``frost`` backend for the Qwen 3.5 GDN block, whose numerics
+these kernels reproduce.  ``PDL`` stays off in every form (it needs the caller's stream contract: its knob below).  A caller's ``Cfg``
+overrides the pick as a whole; a ``NORM_FORM`` of ``None`` is resolved from the requests count by the entry (``resolve_cfg``).
+
+Knobs (every one a ``cutlass.const_expr`` axis of the same kernel body):
+
+* ``TPR`` threads per state row.  A thread holds ``R = TPR / 2`` rows x ``C = 128 / TPR`` consecutive columns of the state (``R * C``
+  = 64 fp32); lane ``l`` of a warp is ``tpr = l // RG`` (its column slice) and ``rg = l % RG`` (its row group, ``RG = 32 / TPR``);
+  its rows are ``BOX_ROWS * rg + R * warp + m`` (``BOX_ROWS = 128 / RG``): ``R`` consecutive, ``R``-aligned rows of state box ``rg``.
+  The row dot products reproduce the reference 16-leaf balanced tree with ``log2(TPR)`` shuffle steps (offsets ``RG << step``).
+* ``K_RESIDENT``: keep the token's k slice in registers across both passes (else re-read it per 8-column group).
+* ``NBUF``: the depth of the padded-box ring the per-token state write-back goes through (one 64 KB slab per buffer).  At ``NBUF >= 2``
+  the ring's WAR wait is ``cp.async.bulk.wait_group.read (NBUF - 2)`` by the issuing lane ahead of the per-token barrier (one
+  barrier per token); at ``NBUF == 1`` the single box is re-used every token behind a second barrier (the issuing lane's
+  ``wait_group.read 0`` between the token's two passes).
+* ``STATE_STREAM``: the state lives in the shared-memory boxes, not in registers: pass 1 reads each row and drops it, pass 2
+  re-reads it, recomputes ``h = S * decay`` (bit-identical) and writes the updated row to the next box -- the <= 128-register form
+  that lets two CTAs share an SM (``NBUF`` 1 or 2 there).
+* ``MIN_CTAS_PER_SM``: the launch's ``min_blocks_per_mp`` = ptxas's register cap (1 -> 255, 2 -> 128 registers per thread); the SASS
+  gate (no ``STL`` / ``LDL``) decides whether a form may use it.
+* ``CTAS_PER_SM``: 0 = natural shared memory, 1 / 2 = a dummy pad that caps the co-resident CTAs per SM at one / two, derived from
+  ``SMEM_PER_SM_BYTES`` -- the DEVICE's shared memory per SM, which the host entry reads from the part.
+* ``BA_PREFETCH_CHUNKS``: how many of the three 2048-element chunks of the BA projection's ``hidden`` rows (all ``T`` tokens) are in
+  flight at once in the BA warpgroup (3 = one load latency, 20 registers per token per chunk; 1 = three latencies, a third of
+  the registers -- the register-capped forms).
+* ``NORM_FORM``: the association of the gated norm's sum of squares, which the reference verify kernel fixes by its CTAs-per-head
+  policy: ``"ctas2"`` (one request: two 64-row halves of 16 four-row chains each, summed last) or ``"ctas1"`` (sixteen eight-row
+  chains); ``None`` = that policy for the compiled requests count.
+* ``STATE_LOAD_PATH``: ``"bulk"`` (the only served path: the slab lands by ``RG`` ``cp.async.bulk`` boxes on one mbarrier in
+  16-B-padded shared-memory boxes, ``LDS.128`` into the row registers).
+* ``STATE_STORE_PATH``: how a token's updated slab reaches its slot: ``"bulk"`` = ``STS.128`` into a ring box, ``fence.proxy.async``,
+  the per-token barrier, ``RG`` ``cp.async.bulk`` box stores (the bulk-copy engine reads the box out: ~64 KB per token per SM through one
+  engine); ``"stg"`` = every lane's 16 x ``st.global.v4`` of its row slices straight to the slot (the LSU path, no ring / fence / wait;
+  the register-resident state only, ``NBUF`` 1 = the landing slab).
+* ``BULK_ISSUE``: ``"single"`` (default) = one lane issues every bulk copy and store (warp 0 lane 0 the slab boxes and the box stores,
+  warp 4 lane 0 the conv operands); ``"spread"`` = lane 0 of several warps (slab box ``b`` by warp ``b mod 4`` of the BA warpgroup, the
+  input rows of token ``t`` by conv warp ``1 + t mod 3``, the store of box ``b`` by warp ``b mod 8``; each issuing lane keeps its own
+  bulk-group ledger).  Under ``spread`` the BA warpgroup passes one more named barrier (``bar.sync 2, 128``) between warp 0 lane 0's
+  state-mbarrier init + fence and the live arm: the issuing warps 1-3 complete bytes on that mbarrier, and a copy landing before the
+  init is visible is undefined (the transaction is lost to the init and the wait never completes -- the form hung at 16 requests
+  before this barrier existed).  Measured neutral against ``single`` at one, two and four requests on cc 10.0 parts: the issue cost is
+  not on the critical path; the store engine's read-out of a 64 KB slab per token per SM is.
+* ``STATE_STORE_PATH`` ``"stg"`` is a measured LOSS on cc 10.0 (close to twice the bulk path's time at one request): with this thread mapping an
+  ``STG.128`` warp instruction touches 32 lines (16 B per 128-B line), ~4k L1 wavefronts per token per CTA against the bulk engine's
+  read-out; kept as the one-flag A/B.
+* ``PDL`` / ``PDL_RELEASE``: ``griddepcontrol.wait`` AFTER the predecessor-independent loads (slot chain, parameters, BA weight rows,
+  the state slab, the conv weights and history) and BEFORE ``z``, ``hidden``, the ``x`` copies and every global write;
+  ``griddepcontrol.launch_dependents`` at entry under ``PDL_RELEASE``.  CALLER OBLIGATION under ``PDL``: the kernel immediately
+  preceding this launch in the stream must not write this layer's ``state``, conv state or slot indices -- the pre-wait loads
+  read them BEFORE ``griddepcontrol.wait``, so a predecessor that writes them (the same layer launched twice in a row) races the
+  slab / history copies against its stores: a wrong state, no error.  The serving chain satisfies it (the predecessor is the
+  QKVZ projection, which writes ``x`` / ``z`` only); the entry cannot check it.
+* ``TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD``: a cluster of two CTAs per V head (grid ``(96, requests)`` in clusters of 2 along x), CTA ``r`` of the pair owning
+  state rows ``64 r .. 64 r + 63`` (``CTA_ROWS`` 64: a 32 KB slab in, 32 KB of write-back per token, ``R = 64 TPR / 256`` rows per thread);
+  both CTAs recompute the BA (decay, beta) and the conv + RMS (q, k, v) of every token from the same inputs; each shifts the V-conv history
+  of its own 64 channels and the reader ticket wraps at 5 (six readers per K head).  The recurrence is row-local, so the T-token chain has
+  ONE cross-CTA datum per token: the gated norm's sum of squares.  The reference association (``NORM_FORM``) never straddles the CTA
+  boundary (chains of 4 or 8 rows; 64 is a multiple of both), so each CTA's norm warp sums its ``NORM_CHAINS_CTA`` local chains, ships
+  the values to the peer (``NORM_XFER_FLOATS`` lanes, one ``st.async ... mbarrier::complete_tx::bytes.f32`` each through ``mapa``, completing
+  ``NORM_XFER_BYTES`` on the peer's ``mb_norm`` stage ``t % 2``) and, after the peer's values land, every lane holds head chain ``l``'s value
+  (its own or the received one, selected on the cluster rank) and the reference sequence of fp32 additions runs unchanged -> both CTAs
+  hold the same bits, bitwise with the one-CTA form.  The ship sits at the top of the next token's iteration and the wait at its bottom,
+  so the DSMEM latency hides under that token's passes; the two mbarrier stages alternate by token parity (the peer's ship of token t + 2
+  follows its wait for token t + 1, which needs this CTA's ship of t + 1, which follows this CTA's wait of token t: the stage is never
+  re-armed or rewritten before its reader is done).  The mbarrier inits are published cluster-wide by the init lane's
+  ``fence.mbarrier_init.release.cluster`` + every thread's ``barrier.cluster.arrive.relaxed`` at entry and one ``barrier.cluster.wait``
+  (acquire) per thread before the first ship (the live tail after the hand-off; the null tail at its start): the kernel's only cluster
+  barrier; no GPU-scope membar, no release arrive.  Needs ``R >= 1`` (TPR >= 4 at 256 threads); use with ``CTAS_PER_SM`` 0 (the natural
+  footprint, ~126 KB at T6, keeps one CTA per SM).  Served by default while ``requests x 96 <= SM count``.
+* ``ROLLED_TOKENS``: the T-token loop traced ONCE (``cutlass.range(T, unroll=1)``; the token body is one ``@cute.jit`` step with the row
+  registers and a two-deep ring of core values loop-carried) instead of once per token: every per-token shared address is computed from
+  the loop variable, the deferred norm and outputs run under the uniform predicates ``t >= 1`` / ``t >= 2`` and the gate ``z`` of token
+  ``t - 2`` is picked from the preloaded T values by a select chain.  The same arithmetic in the same order (bitwise with the unrolled
+  body); what changes is the image: 3712 instructions against 5496 on the pair at T6 (the remaining straight-line code is the T-token BA /
+  conv prologue), for the COLD instruction fetch of the serving regime (every layer's launch finds its code evicted).  Needs the
+  register-resident rows (``STATE_STREAM`` off).  ON in ``PAIR_CFG`` (the fastest pair form with the L2 swept before every launch on a
+  cc 10.0 part; marginally behind the unrolled pair when the code is warm) and in ``CFG`` (the one-CTA form at 2-3 requests, where the
+  rolled loop is the larger win), OFF in ``TWO_CTA_CFG`` (the streamed form carries no row registers).
+* ``DEBUG``: the intermediate dumps (``convout``, ``baout``, ``raw``) for byte-compares of the stages.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
+from typing import Optional
+
+# --- the served geometry (the model's constants; the host entry declines everything else) ---
+K_HEADS = 16
+V_HEADS = 48
+HEAD_DIM = 128
+CONV_WIDTH = 4
+HIDDEN = 5120
+QKV_CHANNELS = 2 * K_HEADS * HEAD_DIM + V_HEADS * HEAD_DIM  # 10240
+K_CHANNEL0 = K_HEADS * HEAD_DIM  # 2048: the first K channel of the QKV slab
+V_CHANNEL0 = 2 * K_HEADS * HEAD_DIM  # 4096: the first V channel
+OUT_ROW = V_HEADS * HEAD_DIM  # 6144 outputs per token row
+THREADS = 256
+WARPS = THREADS // 32
+WARPGROUP = 128
+TOKENS_MIN = 2  # one token per request is the decode step
+CONV_HIST_TAPS = CONV_WIDTH - 1  # the three history columns a - 1 .. a + 1 a token window starts in
+# the reference verify's BA partition: virtual thread v (0..255) sums elements c * 2048 + 8 v + j of the three 2048-element chunks
+# while c * 2048 + 8 v < 5120 (chunk 2 ends at v 128); every lane of the BA warpgroup carries virtual threads v = lane and v = lane + 128
+BA_VTHREADS = 256
+BA_CHUNK = 2048
+BA_CHUNKS = (HIDDEN + BA_CHUNK - 1) // BA_CHUNK  # 3
+RMS_LANES = 16  # the reference RMS layout: lane l of a 16-lane group holds the 8 raw q / k values of columns 8 l .. 8 l + 7
+RMS_COLS = HEAD_DIM // RMS_LANES
+TICKET_STRIDE = 512  # counts[request * 512 + kh * 32]: the per-(request, K head) reader ticket of the conv history
+TICKET_LIMIT = V_HEADS // K_HEADS - 1  # 2: the third reader of a K head's conv history is the last
+NORM_FORMS = ("ctas2", "ctas1")
+STATE_LOAD_PATHS = ("bulk",)
+STATE_STORE_PATHS = ("bulk", "stg")
+BULK_ISSUES = ("spread", "single")
+
+# the state slab of one V head (128 x 128 fp32) and its mbarrier: ONE arrive.expect_tx(STATE_SLAB_BYTES) by warp 0's lane 0, the RG
+# box copies complete the bytes
+STATE_SLAB_BYTES = HEAD_DIM * HEAD_DIM * 4  # 65536
+STATE_MBAR_ARRIVERS = 1
+# the conv-operand mbarrier: ONE arrive.expect_tx(conv_bulk_bytes(T)) by the conv warpgroup's first lane, the bulk copies complete
+CONV_MBAR_ARRIVERS = 1
+# one 16-B chunk between two state boxes shifts the next box by 4 banks: with a phase's 8 lanes on RG distinct boxes (TPR >= 4) or
+# RG consecutive row groups, their 16-B chunks land in 8 distinct bank quads (the bank map: bank = 4 rg + (128 / TPR) tpr + 4 c4)
+STATE_BOX_PAD_BYTES = 16
+# TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD: the peer's norm chain values of token t land by NORM_XFER_FLOATS st.async stores of 4 bytes each on this CTA's
+# mb_norm stage t % 2; its init count is the ONE local arrive.expect_tx by the norm warp's lane 0 (a complete_tx carries no software
+# arrive) -- SUM(arriving lanes) == init count on every path; two stages (token parity), a receive slot of up to 16 chain values each
+NORM_MBAR_ARRIVERS = 1
+NORM_MBAR_STAGES = 2
+NORM_RECV_MAX_FLOATS = 16
+
+# The cc 10.0 / 10.3 part's shared memory per SM (228 KB), its per-CTA opt-in maximum (227 KB) and the driver's per-CTA reserve (1 KB);
+# the host entry REPLACES the first two with the device's own readings, so a hardcoded size never decides an occupancy pad on a
+# part it does not describe.
+SM100_SMEM_PER_SM_BYTES = 228 * 1024
+SM100_SMEM_OPTIN_BYTES = 227 * 1024
+SMEM_CTA_RESERVE_BYTES = 1024
+SMEM_PAD_MARGIN_BYTES = 4096  # keeps the cap robust to the allocation granularity
+
+
+def conv_bulk_copies(tokens: int) -> int:
+    """The ``cp.async.bulk`` copies of one CTA's conv operands: 3 weight runs, 3 pieces x 3 history taps, 3 pieces x T input rows."""
+    return 3 + 3 * CONV_HIST_TAPS + 3 * tokens
+
+
+def conv_bulk_bytes(tokens: int) -> int:
+    """The bytes those copies deliver on the conv-operand mbarrier (= its ``expect_tx``): weights 3 x 1 KB, history 9 x 256 B,
+    inputs 3 T x 256 B."""
+    return 3 * HEAD_DIM * CONV_WIDTH * 2 + 3 * CONV_HIST_TAPS * HEAD_DIM * 2 + 3 * tokens * HEAD_DIM * 2
+
+
+def norm_chain_rows(norm_form: str) -> int:
+    """Rows per gated-norm sum-of-squares chain: the reference's half-warp row count (4 at two CTAs per head, 8 at one)."""
+    return 4 if norm_form == "ctas2" else 8
+
+
+def norm_form_for(requests: int) -> str:
+    """The reference verify kernel's CTAs-per-head policy as a norm association: two CTAs at one request, one otherwise."""
+    return "ctas2" if requests == 1 else "ctas1"
+
+
+def _slot16(nbytes: int) -> int:
+    return (nbytes + 15) // 16 * 16
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Cfg:
+    TPR: int = 4
+    K_RESIDENT: bool = True
+    NBUF: int = 3
+    STATE_STREAM: bool = False
+    MIN_CTAS_PER_SM: int = 1
+    CTAS_PER_SM: int = 1
+    BA_PREFETCH_CHUNKS: int = 3
+    NORM_FORM: Optional[str] = None
+    STATE_LOAD_PATH: str = "bulk"
+    STATE_STORE_PATH: str = "bulk"
+    BULK_ISSUE: str = "single"
+    PDL: bool = False
+    PDL_RELEASE: bool = False
+    TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD: bool = False
+    ROLLED_TOKENS: bool = False
+    DEBUG: bool = False
+    SMEM_PER_SM_BYTES: int = SM100_SMEM_PER_SM_BYTES
+    SMEM_OPTIN_BYTES: int = SM100_SMEM_OPTIN_BYTES
+
+    # --- derived (read-only) ---
+    @property
+    def THREADS(self) -> int:
+        return THREADS
+
+    @property
+    def WARPS(self) -> int:
+        return WARPS
+
+    @property
+    def CTAS_PER_HEAD(self) -> int:
+        return 2 if self.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD else 1
+
+    @property
+    def CTA_ROWS(self) -> int:
+        """State rows one CTA owns (128, or 64 on the two-CTAs-per-head form: CTA ``r`` of the pair owns rows ``64 r ..``)."""
+        return HEAD_DIM // self.CTAS_PER_HEAD
+
+    @property
+    def R(self) -> int:
+        """State rows per thread."""
+        return self.CTA_ROWS * self.TPR // THREADS
+
+    @property
+    def C(self) -> int:
+        """State columns per thread (one 8-column group = one reference lane partial)."""
+        return HEAD_DIM // self.TPR
+
+    @property
+    def GROUPS(self) -> int:
+        return self.C // 8
+
+    @property
+    def RG(self) -> int:
+        """Row groups per warp = the lanes that share a column slice index; lane ``l`` is ``tpr = l // RG``, ``rg = l % RG``."""
+        return 32 // self.TPR
+
+    @property
+    def BOX_ROWS(self) -> int:
+        """State rows per box (the rows the ``rg`` lanes of every warp hold together); box ``rg`` = this CTA's rows ``BOX_ROWS rg ..``."""
+        return self.CTA_ROWS // self.RG
+
+    @property
+    def V_PERM_STRIDE(self) -> int:
+        """The permuted ``v_s`` index of head row ``u`` is ``(u % BOX_ROWS) * V_PERM_STRIDE + u // BOX_ROWS`` (``RG x CTAS_PER_HEAD``): the
+        RG lanes of a phase read consecutive words, and a two-CTA pair reads disjoint halves of the same 128-entry array."""
+        return HEAD_DIM // self.BOX_ROWS
+
+    @property
+    def STATE_SLAB_BYTES_CTA(self) -> int:
+        """Bytes of the state rows this CTA loads and stores (the slab mbarrier's expect_tx): 65536, or 32768 on the two-CTA form."""
+        return self.CTA_ROWS * HEAD_DIM * 4
+
+    @property
+    def TICKET_LIMIT(self) -> int:
+        """The last reader ticket of a K head's conv history: ``3 x CTAS_PER_HEAD`` CTAs read it, the one that draws this value shifts it."""
+        return (V_HEADS // K_HEADS) * self.CTAS_PER_HEAD - 1
+
+    @property
+    def SLICE_PITCH(self) -> int:
+        """fp32 elements between two threads' q / k slices in shared memory: C + 4 spreads the TPR slices over distinct banks."""
+        return self.C + 4
+
+    @property
+    def BULK_STATE(self) -> bool:
+        return self.STATE_LOAD_PATH == "bulk"
+
+    @property
+    def BULK_STORE(self) -> bool:
+        return self.STATE_STORE_PATH == "bulk"
+
+    @property
+    def SPREAD_ISSUE(self) -> bool:
+        return self.BULK_ISSUE == "spread"
+
+    @property
+    def STATE_BOX_BYTES(self) -> int:
+        """Bytes of one state box = ``BOX_ROWS`` rows of 128 fp32, one contiguous run in global memory and in shared memory."""
+        return self.BOX_ROWS * HEAD_DIM * 4
+
+    @property
+    def STATE_BOX_PITCH_ELEMS(self) -> int:
+        """fp32 elements between two boxes in shared memory (the box plus the 16-B pad)."""
+        return self.BOX_ROWS * HEAD_DIM + STATE_BOX_PAD_BYTES // 4
+
+    @property
+    def SLAB_SMEM_ELEMS(self) -> int:
+        """fp32 elements of one ring buffer: the RG padded boxes of a slab."""
+        return self.RG * self.STATE_BOX_PITCH_ELEMS
+
+    @property
+    def RING_SMEM_ELEMS(self) -> int:
+        return self.NBUF * self.SLAB_SMEM_ELEMS
+
+    @property
+    def NORM_CHAINS(self) -> int:
+        """Sum-of-squares chains of the gated norm (one lane of the norm warp each): 32 four-row chains or 16 eight-row chains."""
+        return HEAD_DIM // norm_chain_rows(self.NORM_FORM)
+
+    @property
+    def NORM_CHAIN_ROWS(self) -> int:
+        return norm_chain_rows(self.NORM_FORM)
+
+    @property
+    def NORM_CHAINS_CTA(self) -> int:
+        """Sum-of-squares chains whose rows this CTA owns (16 or 8 on the two-CTA form; all of them on the one-CTA form)."""
+        return self.NORM_CHAINS // self.CTAS_PER_HEAD
+
+    @property
+    def NORM_XFER_FLOATS(self) -> int:
+        """Chain values each CTA of a pair ships to its peer per token (one lane, one ``st.async`` of 4 bytes each); 0 on the one-CTA form."""
+        return self.NORM_CHAINS_CTA if self.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD else 0
+
+    @property
+    def NORM_XFER_BYTES(self) -> int:
+        """The peer's ``mb_norm`` expect_tx per token (= the bytes the NORM_XFER_FLOATS ``st.async`` stores complete)."""
+        return 4 * self.NORM_XFER_FLOATS
+
+    def natural_smem_bytes(self, tokens: int) -> int:
+        """The kernel's own shared-memory footprint for ``tokens`` per request, buffer by buffer in allocation order (16-byte slots):
+        the x rows, conv weights, conv history, raw q / k, the padded q / k slices, v, the per-token scalars, the two core-value
+        slots of the norm, the two norm inverses, the BA partials, the ticket, the two mbarriers, (the pair's norm receive slots and
+        its two mbarrier stages,) the state ring."""
+        return (
+            _slot16(3 * tokens * HEAD_DIM * 2)  # x_s
+            + 3 * HEAD_DIM * CONV_WIDTH * 2  # cw_s
+            + 3 * CONV_HIST_TAPS * HEAD_DIM * 2  # hist_s
+            + 2 * tokens * HEAD_DIM * 4  # qk_raw
+            + 2 * tokens * self.TPR * self.SLICE_PITCH * 4  # q_s, k_s
+            + tokens * HEAD_DIM * 4  # v_s
+            + _slot16(4 * tokens * 4)  # scal_s
+            + 2 * HEAD_DIM * 4  # o_s
+            + 16  # inv_s
+            + _slot16(2 * WARPS * tokens * 4)  # ba_part
+            + 16  # ticket_s
+            + 16
+            + 16  # mb_ops, mb_state (8 bytes each in a 16-byte slot)
+            + ((NORM_MBAR_STAGES * NORM_RECV_MAX_FLOATS * 4 + NORM_MBAR_STAGES * 8) if self.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD else 0)  # norm_recv_s, mb_norm
+            + self.RING_SMEM_ELEMS * 4  # ring
+        )
+
+    def smem_pad_bytes(self, tokens: int) -> int:
+        """The occupancy pad: sized so that ``CTAS_PER_SM + 1`` CTAs (each its footprint + pad + the driver's reserve) exceed the
+        device's shared memory per SM while ``CTAS_PER_SM`` of them fit -- the SM holds at most ``CTAS_PER_SM`` CTAs by shared memory."""
+        if self.CTAS_PER_SM == 0:
+            return 0
+        pad = self.SMEM_PER_SM_BYTES // (self.CTAS_PER_SM + 1) + SMEM_PAD_MARGIN_BYTES - SMEM_CTA_RESERVE_BYTES - self.natural_smem_bytes(tokens)
+        return max(0, _slot16(pad))
+
+    def smem_bytes(self, tokens: int) -> int:
+        return self.natural_smem_bytes(tokens) + self.smem_pad_bytes(tokens)
+
+    def max_tokens(self) -> int:
+        """The largest tokens-per-request count whose footprint fits this part's per-CTA opt-in (and, with a pad, the SM)."""
+        best = 0
+        for tokens in range(TOKENS_MIN, 65):
+            if self.natural_smem_bytes(tokens) > self.SMEM_OPTIN_BYTES:
+                break
+            if self.CTAS_PER_SM and self.CTAS_PER_SM * (self.smem_bytes(tokens) + SMEM_CTA_RESERVE_BYTES) > self.SMEM_PER_SM_BYTES:
+                break
+            best = tokens
+        return best
+
+
+def validate_cfg(cfg: Cfg) -> None:
+    """Raise the typed error of every unexpressible knob combination (structural invariants raise here, never a module assert)."""
+    if cfg.TPR not in (2, 4, 8, 16):
+        raise ValueError(f"gdn_verify_fused: TPR must be 2, 4, 8 or 16, got {cfg.TPR}")
+    if cfg.CTA_ROWS * cfg.TPR % THREADS or cfg.R < 1 or cfg.R * cfg.C * THREADS != cfg.CTA_ROWS * HEAD_DIM or cfg.C % 8 or cfg.BOX_ROWS != cfg.R * WARPS:
+        raise ValueError(f"gdn_verify_fused: TPR={cfg.TPR} does not tile the {cfg.CTA_ROWS} x 128 state rows of one CTA over {THREADS} threads")
+    if cfg.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD and any(cfg.CTA_ROWS % norm_chain_rows(f) or (HEAD_DIM // norm_chain_rows(f)) % cfg.CTAS_PER_HEAD for f in NORM_FORMS):
+        raise ValueError("gdn_verify_fused: TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD needs every norm association's chains to split by CTA without straddling")
+    if cfg.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD and cfg.NORM_FORM is not None and cfg.NORM_CHAINS_CTA > NORM_RECV_MAX_FLOATS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"gdn_verify_fused: TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD ships at most {NORM_RECV_MAX_FLOATS} chain values per token, {cfg.NORM_FORM} needs {cfg.NORM_CHAINS_CTA}"
+        )
+    if cfg.NBUF not in (1, 2, 3, 4):
+        raise ValueError(f"gdn_verify_fused: NBUF must be 1 .. 4, got {cfg.NBUF}")
+    if cfg.STATE_STREAM and cfg.NBUF > 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"gdn_verify_fused: STATE_STREAM keeps the state in the boxes and alternates two of them at most; NBUF={cfg.NBUF}")
+    if cfg.MIN_CTAS_PER_SM not in (1, 2):
+        raise ValueError(f"gdn_verify_fused: MIN_CTAS_PER_SM must be 1 or 2, got {cfg.MIN_CTAS_PER_SM}")
+    if cfg.CTAS_PER_SM not in (0, 1, 2):

+BF16 = cutlass.BFloat16
+INT32 = cutlass.Int32
+INT64 = cutlass.Int64
+UINT8 = cutlass.Uint8
+
+# the reference's q scale constant 128 ** -0.5 (its fp32 literal), the RMS epsilon and the softplus threshold
+Q_SCALE = 0.08838834764831845
+RMS_EPS = 1e-6
+SOFTPLUS_LINEAR_ABOVE = 20.0
+ROW_BYTES = HEAD_DIM * 4  # one state row in the shared-memory boxes (the natural 512-B pitch inside a box)
+NORM_WARP = 1  # the warp that sums the gated norm's squares (warp 0's lane 0 owns the state mbarrier and the bulk stores)
+SHIFT_THREADS = 3 * HEAD_DIM // 8  # 48: one 16-B (8-channel) group of the three pieces per thread and conv-state column
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# PTX forms shared with the reference kernel (inline PTX through the DSL primitive; outputs number first, inputs after)
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _unpack_bf16x2(word):
+    """A bf16x2 word -> (lo, hi) as fp32: ``shl 16`` / ``and 0xffff0000`` (the reference helper's exact ``* 1.0`` dropped)."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx(
+        "{\n\t.reg .b32 t;\n\tshl.b32 t, $2, 16;\n\tmov.b32 $0, t;\n\tand.b32 t, $2, 0xffff0000;\n\tmov.b32 $1, t;\n\t}",
+        write_only_types=[FP32, FP32],
+        read_only_args=[word],
+    )
+
+
+def _stock_conv_silu(value):
+    """The stock causal-conv SiLU: ``x / (1 + ex2(-x * log2 e))`` with ``ex2.approx`` and ``div.full``."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx(
+        "{\n\t.reg .f32 t, e, d;\n\tmul.f32 t, $1, 0fBFB8AA3B;\n\tex2.approx.f32 e, t;\n\tadd.f32 d, e, 0f3F800000;\n\tdiv.full.f32 $0, $1, d;\n\t}",
+        write_only_types=[FP32],
+        read_only_args=[value],
+    )
+
+
+def _quant_fp8_word(value, scale):
+    """The stock per-tensor FP8 quantization: ``v * (1 / scale)`` with a ``div.rn`` reciprocal, ``cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2``; the
+    e4m3 byte is the low byte of the returned word."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx(
+        "{\n\t.reg .f32 inv, v;\n\t.reg .b16 p;\n\tdiv.rn.f32 inv, 0f3F800000, $2;\n\tmul.f32 v, $1, inv;\n\t"
+        "cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2.f32 p, 0f00000000, v;\n\tcvt.u32.u16 $0, p;\n\t}",
+        write_only_types=[INT32],
+        read_only_args=[value, scale],
+    )
+
+
+def _mul_rn_f32(a, b):
+    """An fp32 product the compiler cannot fuse into a following add (the reference's explicit ``mul.rn`` of the decay step and the
+    unfused squares of the norm)."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx("mul.rn.f32 $0, $1, $2;", write_only_types=[FP32], read_only_args=[a, b])
+
+
+def _fma_rn_f32(a, b, c):
+    """The reference's explicit ``fma.rn.f32`` of the state update (``h = fma(inn, k, h)``: one rounding, never re-contracted)."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx("fma.rn.f32 $0, $1, $2, $3;", write_only_types=[FP32], read_only_args=[a, b, c])
+
+
+def _atom_inc_relaxed_gpu(addr, limit):
+    """``atom.relaxed.gpu.global.inc.u32``: the reader ticket; returns the old value, wraps to 0 past ``limit``."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx("atom.relaxed.gpu.global.inc.u32 $0, [$1], $2;", write_only_types=[INT32], read_only_args=[addr, limit])
+
+
+def _smem_addr(arr):
+    """32-bit shared-window address of a shared-memory ``cutlass.Array``."""
+    return INT32(arr.data_ptr().toint())
+
+
+def _mapa_u32(addr32, rank):
+    """``mapa.shared::cluster``: this CTA's shared-window address translated to the same offset in cluster CTA ``rank``'s window."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx("mapa.shared::cluster.u32 $0, $1, $2;", write_only_types=[INT32], read_only_args=[addr32, rank])
+
+
+def _st_async_f32(peer_addr32, value, peer_mbar32):
+    """One fp32 into a peer CTA's shared memory, completing 4 tx bytes on the peer's mbarrier (``st.async``; the DSMEM path, not the
+    bulk-copy unit -- the write-back boxes queued there would delay it).  Both addresses are ``mapa``-translated."""
+    nvvm.inline_ptx("st.async.weak.shared::cluster.mbarrier::complete_tx::bytes.f32 [$0], $1, [$2];", read_only_args=[peer_addr32, value, peer_mbar32])
+
+
+def _cta_barrier():
+    """The CTA-wide barrier (id 0, every thread) in its NON-aligned form: the role arms are two traced bodies (two PCs), which the
+    ``.aligned`` promise does not cover -- synccheck flags the aligned form as divergent; the hardware barrier counts arrivals per id."""
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync(0, thread_count=THREADS)
+
+
+def _wg_barrier(barrier_id):
+    """A warpgroup-local named barrier (128 threads): the NON-aligned ``barrier.sync id, 128``, reached from a warp-role branch."""
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync(barrier_id, thread_count=WARPGROUP)
+
+
+def _select_f32(cond, a, b):
+    """``cond ? a : b`` on fp32 values as one select (no branch)."""
+    return FP32(arith.select(cond.ir_value(), a.ir_value(), b.ir_value()))
+
+
+def _balanced_sum(parts):
+    """The balanced binary tree over ``parts`` in order (``((p0+p1)+(p2+p3))+...``); one part returns itself."""
+    while len(parts) > 1:
+        parts = [parts[i] + parts[i + 1] for i in range(0, len(parts), 2)]
+    return parts[0]
+
+
+def _gmem_ptr(tensor, elem_offset, dtype):
+    """A 16-byte-aligned GLOBAL pointer to ``tensor[elem_offset]`` for the bulk copies (``cp.async.bulk`` wants an explicit gmem
+    address space)."""
+    return cute.make_ptr(dtype, (tensor.iterator + elem_offset).toint(), cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=16)
+
+
+def _gaddr(tensor, elem_offset):
+    """The 64-bit generic address of ``tensor[elem_offset]`` (for the 128-bit vector loads / stores)."""
+    return (tensor.iterator + elem_offset).toint()
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# straight-line helpers (plain Python: traced inline, no DSL control flow inside)
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _conv_piece_channel0(piece, head, kh):
+    """The first QKV channel of piece ``piece`` (0 = this K head's Q, 1 = its K, 2 = this V head's V)."""
+    if piece == 0:
+        return kh * HEAD_DIM
+    if piece == 1:
+        return K_CHANNEL0 + kh * HEAD_DIM
+    return V_CHANNEL0 + head * HEAD_DIM
+
+
+def _box_offset(cfg, slot, head, r, SS, b):
+    """The element offset of box ``b`` of the rows CTA ``r`` of head ``head`` owns in slot ``slot``: the one-CTA form's committed
+    arithmetic (``slot SS + head 16384 + b BOX_ROWS 128``), plus ``CTA_ROWS r x 128`` on the pair only (so the one-CTA cubin is untouched)."""
+    off = slot * SS + head * HEAD_DIM * HEAD_DIM + b * cfg.BOX_ROWS * HEAD_DIM
+    if cfg.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD:
+        off = off + r * (cfg.CTA_ROWS * HEAD_DIM)
+    return off
+
+
+def _issue_state_box(cfg, state, ring, mb_state, slot, head, r, SS, b):
+    """The slab's box ``b`` (this CTA's rows ``BOX_ROWS b ..``, one contiguous run in global memory) into ring buffer 0 at box pitch
+    ``STATE_BOX_PITCH_ELEMS``, completing on the state mbarrier (armed once, by warp 0 lane 0, with the whole slab's bytes)."""
+    nvvm.cp_async_bulk_shared_cluster_global(
+        ring.subview(b * cfg.STATE_BOX_PITCH_ELEMS),
+        _gmem_ptr(state, _box_offset(cfg, slot, head, r, SS, b), FP32),
+        mb_state,
+        cfg.STATE_BOX_BYTES,
+    )
+
+
+def _issue_state_store_box(cfg, state, ring, buf, slot, head, r, SS, b):
+    """Box ``b`` of ring buffer ``buf`` to slot ``slot`` (``cp.async.bulk.global.shared::cta.bulk_group``); the issuing lane commits."""
+    nvvm.cp_async_bulk_global_shared_cta(
+        _gmem_ptr(state, _box_offset(cfg, slot, head, r, SS, b), FP32),
+        ring.subview(buf * cfg.SLAB_SMEM_ELEMS + b * cfg.STATE_BOX_PITCH_ELEMS),
+        cfg.STATE_BOX_BYTES,
+    )
+
+
+def _store_row_gmem(state, slot, head, rowm, col0, vals, SS):
+    """One updated row slice straight to its slot by 16-B vector stores (the ``stg`` store path)."""
+    base = (state.iterator + (slot * SS + (head * HEAD_DIM + rowm) * HEAD_DIM + col0)).toint()
+    for c4 in range(len(vals) // 4):
+        st_global_v4(base + 16 * c4, vals[4 * c4 : 4 * c4 + 4], FP32)
+
+
+def _issue_conv_param_copies(cw, cs, cw_s, hist_s, mb_arr, head, kh, cv_slot, hist0, CSS, CST):
+    """The ``cp.async.bulk`` copies of this head's conv WEIGHTS (3 x 1 KB) and the HISTORY taps ``a - 1 .. a + 1`` of its three pieces
+    (9 x 256 B; ``hist0`` = column ``a - 1`` of the channel-contiguous pool): written by earlier steps, never by the predecessor
+    grid, so they are issued ahead of a PDL wait."""
+    for piece in range(3):
+        ch0 = _conv_piece_channel0(piece, head, kh)
+        nvvm.cp_async_bulk_shared_cluster_global(
+            cw_s.subview(piece * HEAD_DIM * CONV_WIDTH), _gmem_ptr(cw, ch0 * CONV_WIDTH, BF16), mb_arr, HEAD_DIM * CONV_WIDTH * 2
+        )
+        for tap in range(CONV_HIST_TAPS):
+            nvvm.cp_async_bulk_shared_cluster_global(
+                hist_s.subview((piece * CONV_HIST_TAPS + tap) * HEAD_DIM),
+                _gmem_ptr(cs, cv_slot * CSS + (hist0 + tap) * CST + ch0, BF16),
+                mb_arr,
+                HEAD_DIM * 2,
+            )
+
+
+def _issue_conv_x_copies(qkv, x_s, mb_arr, row, head, kh, XS, t):
+    """The three 256-B copies of this head's Q / K / V pieces of token ``t``'s input row (``row`` = its 64-bit row index, clamped to
+    the request's last token): the predecessor's output, issued after a PDL wait."""
+    for piece in range(3):
+        ch0 = _conv_piece_channel0(piece, head, kh)
+        nvvm.cp_async_bulk_shared_cluster_global(x_s.subview((t * 3 + piece) * HEAD_DIM), _gmem_ptr(qkv, row * XS + ch0, BF16), mb_arr, HEAD_DIM * 2)
+
+
+def _conv_value(x_s, hist_s, taps, t, piece, u):
+    """The reference conv unit for channel ``u`` of ``piece`` at token ``t``: the four window entries ``seq[t + e]`` of ``seq =
+    [old[a - 1], old[a], old[a + 1], x_0 .. x_{T-1}]`` times taps ``0 .. 3`` (tap 3 on the newest), each product rounded to bf16, summed
+    in tap order from +0, the stock SiLU, bf16.  Returns the bf16 value as fp32."""
+    acc = FP32(0)
+    for e in range(CONV_WIDTH):
+        s = t + e
+        if s < CONV_HIST_TAPS:
+            xv = hist_s[(piece * CONV_HIST_TAPS + s) * HEAD_DIM + u].to(FP32)
+        else:
+            xv = x_s[((s - CONV_HIST_TAPS) * 3 + piece) * HEAD_DIM + u].to(FP32)
+        prod = (xv * taps[e]).to(BF16).to(FP32)
+        acc = acc + prod
+    return _stock_conv_silu(acc).to(BF16).to(FP32)
+
+
+def _slice_values(base_addr, n):
+    """``n`` fp32 values (a multiple of 4) from shared memory by 16-B vector loads."""
+    vals = []
+    for c4 in range(n // 4):
+        vals.extend(ld_shared_v4(base_addr + 16 * c4, FP32))
+    return vals
+
+
+def _store_slice(base_addr, vals):
+    """``vals`` (a multiple of 4 fp32) to shared memory by 16-B vector stores."""
+    for c4 in range(len(vals) // 4):
+        st_shared_v4(base_addr + 16 * c4, vals[4 * c4 : 4 * c4 + 4], FP32)
+
+
+def _load_row_smem(sbase, m, C):
+    """One row slice (``C`` fp32) from the thread's shared-memory box (``sbase`` = its first row's slice address; 512-B row pitch)."""
+    return _slice_values(sbase + m * ROW_BYTES, C)
+
+
+def _store_row_smem(sbase, m, vals):
+    _store_slice(sbase + m * ROW_BYTES, vals)
+
+
+def _k_group(k, kbase, g, cfg):
+    """The 8 k values of 8-column group ``g``: from the resident slice, or re-read from shared memory (``K_RESIDENT`` off)."""
+    return k[8 * g : 8 * g + 8] if cfg.K_RESIDENT else _slice_values(kbase + 32 * g, 8)
+
+
+def _row_reduce(cfg, parts):
+    """The reference 16-leaf tree over a row's 8-column partials: the balanced tree over the thread's groups, then ``log2(TPR)``
+    xor shuffles with offsets ``RG << step`` (the partners differ in the tpr lane bits)."""
+    s = _balanced_sum(parts)
+    for step in range(cfg.TPR.bit_length() - 1):
+        s = s + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(s, offset=cfg.RG << step)
+    return s
+
+
+def _pass1(cfg, S_rows, src_base, k, k_base, decay):
+    """Pass 1 of a token: ``h = mul.rn(S, decay)`` per row (kept for the register-resident form, dropped when streamed) and ``dot =
+    h . k`` per row: per 8-column group an 8-step FFMA chain from +0 (the group's k values loaded once and shared by the thread's
+    rows), the groups combined by the reference 16-leaf tree.  Returns (the decayed rows or None, the dots)."""
+    R, C, G = cfg.R, cfg.C, cfg.GROUPS
+    streamed = S_rows is None
+    h = []
+    for m in range(R):
+        S = _load_row_smem(src_base, m, C) if streamed else S_rows[m]
+        h.append([_mul_rn_f32(S[j], decay) for j in range(C)])
+    parts = [[] for _ in range(R)]
+    for g in range(G):
+        kg = _k_group(k, k_base, g, cfg)
+        for m in range(R):
+            p = FP32(0)
+            for j in range(8):
+                p = p + h[m][8 * g + j] * kg[j]
+            parts[m].append(p)
+    dots = [_row_reduce(cfg, parts[m]) for m in range(R)]
+    return (None if streamed else h), dots
+
+
+def _pass2(cfg, h_rows, src_base, dst_base, k, k_base, q_base, inn, decay, store_smem):
+    """Pass 2 of a token: ``h = fma.rn(inn, k, h)`` (the streamed form re-reads the row and recomputes ``mul.rn(S, decay)`` first:
+    bit-identical), ``o = h . q`` (the same chains and tree; each q / k group loaded once per token), the updated slice to ring box
+    ``dst_base``.  Returns (the new rows or None, the per-row ``f32(bf16(o))`` core values)."""
+    R, C, G = cfg.R, cfg.C, cfg.GROUPS
+    streamed = h_rows is None
+    if streamed:
+        h = []
+        for m in range(R):
+            S = _load_row_smem(src_base, m, C)
+            h.append([_mul_rn_f32(S[j], decay) for j in range(C)])
+    else:
+        h = h_rows
+    parts = [[] for _ in range(R)]
+    for g in range(G):
+        kg = _k_group(k, k_base, g, cfg)
+        qg = _slice_values(q_base + 32 * g, 8)
+        for m in range(R):
+            o = FP32(0)
+            for j in range(8):
+                idx = 8 * g + j
+                h[m][idx] = _fma_rn_f32(inn[m], kg[j], h[m][idx])
+                o = o + h[m][idx] * qg[j]
+            parts[m].append(o)
+    values = []
+    for m in range(R):
+        values.append(_row_reduce(cfg, parts[m]).to(BF16).to(FP32))
+        if store_smem:
+            _store_row_smem(dst_base, m, h[m])
+    return (None if streamed else h), values
+
+
+def _pick_row_value(values, tpr):
+    """``values[tpr]`` for ``tpr < R`` by a select chain (every lane holds every row's value after the butterflies)."""
+    val = values[0]
+    for m in range(1, len(values)):
+        val = _select_f32(tpr == m, values[m], val)
+    return val
+
+
+def _norm_inverse(cfg, o_s, slot, lane, EPS):
+    """The gated-norm inverse of one token from its 128 core values (``o_s`` slot ``slot``, a Python int or a traced value), by the 32 lanes of one warp: lane ``c``
+    sums the squares of chain ``c``'s rows sequentially (the reference half-warp's ``ss += core * core``, an fp32 chain over 4 rows
+    at NORM_FORM ctas2 or 8 rows at ctas1), the chains are summed in chain order (ctas2: the two 64-row halves summed last; fp32
+    addition commutes exactly, so both of the reference's ranks hold the same bits) and ``inv = rsqrt(ss / 128 + eps)``."""
+    CR = cfg.NORM_CHAIN_ROWS
+    chains = cfg.NORM_CHAINS
+    chain = lane if chains == 32 else lane % 16
+    base = slot * HEAD_DIM + chain * CR
+    v0 = o_s[base]
+    ss = _mul_rn_f32(v0, v0)
+    for i in range(1, CR):
+        v = o_s[base + i]
+        ss = ss + _mul_rn_f32(v, v)
+    if chains == 32:
+        tot0 = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(ss, 0)
+        for c in range(1, 16):
+            tot0 = tot0 + cute.arch.shuffle_sync(ss, c)
+        tot1 = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(ss, 16)
+        for c in range(17, 32):
+            tot1 = tot1 + cute.arch.shuffle_sync(ss, c)
+        total = tot0 + tot1
+    else:
+        total = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(ss, 0)
+        for c in range(1, 16):
+            total = total + cute.arch.shuffle_sync(ss, c)
+    return cute.math.rsqrt(total / FP32(HEAD_DIM) + FP32(EPS))
+
+
+def _norm_chain_sum(cfg, o_s, slot, lane):
+    """TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD: lane ``l`` of the norm warp sums the squares of LOCAL chain ``l % NORM_CHAINS_CTA`` (``NORM_CHAIN_ROWS``
+    consecutive rows of this CTA's 64, the reference half-warp's sequential ``ss += core * core``) from ``o_s`` slot ``slot`` (a Python
+    int on the unrolled loop, a traced value on the rolled one: plain address arithmetic either way)."""
+    CR = cfg.NORM_CHAIN_ROWS
+    base = slot * HEAD_DIM + (lane % cfg.NORM_CHAINS_CTA) * CR
+    v0 = o_s[base]
+    ss = _mul_rn_f32(v0, v0)
+    for i in range(1, CR):
+        v = o_s[base + i]
+        ss = ss + _mul_rn_f32(v, v)
+    return ss
+
+
+def _norm_inverse_pair(cfg, ss, peer, r, lane, EPS):
+    """TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD: the gated-norm inverse of one token from this CTA's chain sums (``ss``: lane ``l`` holds local chain ``l %
+    NCH``) and the peer's (``peer``: lane ``l`` holds the peer's chain ``l % NCH``, read from the receive slot).  Lane ``l < NORM_CHAINS``
+    holds HEAD chain ``l``: its own when ``l // NCH == r``, the peer's otherwise (one select on the cluster rank); then the reference
+    association runs over the head chains in order exactly as the one-CTA form's ``_norm_inverse`` (ctas2: the two 64-row halves
+    summed sequentially, then added -- fp32 addition commutes exactly, so both ranks hold the same bits; ctas1: one sequence)."""
+    NCH = cfg.NORM_CHAINS_CTA
+    chains = cfg.NORM_CHAINS
+    val = _select_f32((lane // NCH) == r, ss, peer)
+    if chains == 32:
+        tot0 = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(val, 0)
+        for c in range(1, 16):
+            tot0 = tot0 + cute.arch.shuffle_sync(val, c)
+        tot1 = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(val, 16)
+        for c in range(17, 32):
+            tot1 = tot1 + cute.arch.shuffle_sync(val, c)
+        total = tot0 + tot1
+    else:
+        total = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(val, 0)
+        for c in range(1, 16):
+            total = total + cute.arch.shuffle_sync(val, c)
+    return cute.math.rsqrt(total / FP32(HEAD_DIM) + FP32(EPS))
+
+
+def _pick_dyn(values, idx):
+    """``values[idx]`` for a DYNAMIC ``idx`` by a select chain over the static list."""
+    val = values[0]
+    for i in range(1, len(values)):
+        val = _select_f32(idx == i, values[i], val)
+    return val
+
+
+def _emit_output(cfg, values, tpr, inv, wv, zv, scv, oi, out, qout, raw):
+    """The output of one (token, row) pair: ``bf16(((core * inv) * w) * (z / (1 + exp(-z))))`` -> ``out``, its static FP8 -> ``qout``."""
+    val = _pick_row_value(values, tpr)
+    rounded = (((val * inv) * wv) * (zv / (FP32(1) + cute.math.exp(-zv)))).to(BF16)
+    qout[oi] = _quant_fp8_word(rounded.to(FP32), scv).to(UINT8)
+    out[oi] = rounded
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.DEBUG):
+        raw[oi] = val.to(BF16)
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# the BA role (warpgroup 0): the state mbarrier + slab issue, the reference 256-virtual-thread BA partition for T tokens
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+@cute.jit
+def _ba_role(
+    cfg: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    tid,
+    head,
+    r,
+    n,
+    bos,
+    ntok,
+    live,
+    src,
+    al,
+    dt,
+    hidden,
+    baweight,
+    state,
+    scal_s,
+    ba_part,
+    mb_state,
+    mb_norm,
+    ring,
+    baout,
+    SS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    T: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    u = tid  # 0 .. 127: virtual threads u (chunks 0 .. 2) and u + 128 (chunks 0, 1) of the reference partition
+    wl = tid // 32
+    lane = tid % 32
+    P = cfg.BA_PREFETCH_CHUNKS
+    if wl == 0:
+        if lane == 0:
+            nvvm.mbarrier_init(mb_state, STATE_MBAR_ARRIVERS)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD):
+                # the two stages of the norm exchange (token parity): the peer's st.async completes bytes on them, so their init is
+                # published cluster-wide (fence.mbarrier_init.release.cluster + the relaxed cluster arrive below + the cluster wait in
+                # the tail) before any ship
+                for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(NORM_MBAR_STAGES):
+                    nvvm.mbarrier_init(mb_norm.subview(s), NORM_MBAR_ARRIVERS)
+            nvvm.fence_mbarrier_init()  # published to the 256 waiters by the hand-off barrier, which every waiter passes first
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.SPREAD_ISSUE):
+        # the issuing warps 1-3 complete bytes on mb_state from the live arm below: the init + fence must reach them through a barrier
+        # FIRST (a copy completing on an mbarrier whose init is not yet visible is undefined -- the transaction is lost to the init and
+        # the wait never completes; the form hung at 16 requests without this) -- the mirror of the conv warpgroup's bar.sync 1 after
+        # its init.  Under single the init lane is the only issuing lane and the hand-off barrier publishes the init to the waiters.
+        _wg_barrier(2)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD):
+        # P4 step 3: every thread of both CTAs arrives (relaxed; the init lane's fence.mbarrier_init orders its inits ahead) -- the
+        # matching cluster wait sits in the tail, before the first st.async may land on this CTA's mb_norm
+        nvvm.barrier_cluster_arrive_relaxed()
+    alv = al[head].to(FP32)
+    dtv = dt[head].to(FP32)
+    # the two BA weight rows: parameters, never a predecessor's output -> ahead of a PDL wait
+    bw0, aw0, bw1, aw1 = [], [], [], []
+    for wc in cutlass.range_constexpr(BA_CHUNKS):
+        kk = wc * BA_CHUNK + u * 8
+        bw0.append(ld_global_v4(_gaddr(baweight, head * HIDDEN + kk), INT32))
+        aw0.append(ld_global_v4(_gaddr(baweight, (head + V_HEADS) * HIDDEN + kk), INT32))
+        if cutlass.const_expr(wc * BA_CHUNK + WARPGROUP * 8 < HIDDEN):
+            bw1.append(ld_global_v4(_gaddr(baweight, head * HIDDEN + kk + WARPGROUP * 8), INT32))
+            aw1.append(ld_global_v4(_gaddr(baweight, (head + V_HEADS) * HIDDEN + kk + WARPGROUP * 8), INT32))
+    if live:
+        if lane == 0:
+            # warp 0 arms the slab's bytes once; box b is issued by warp b mod 4 (spread: the init reached these lanes through the
+            # warpgroup barrier above) or by warp 0 (single) -- a copy that lands before the arm only drives the tx-count negative
+            # until the arm, the phase cannot complete before the arrival
+            if wl == 0:
+                nvvm.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(mb_state, cfg.STATE_SLAB_BYTES_CTA)
+            for b in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.RG):
+                if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.SPREAD_ISSUE):
+                    if wl == b % (WARPGROUP // 32):
+                        _issue_state_box(cfg, state, ring, mb_state, src, head, r, SS, b)
+                else:
+                    if wl == 0:
+                        _issue_state_box(cfg, state, ring, mb_state, src, head, r, SS, b)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.PDL):
+            # everything above was written before this step's graph; the normed hidden the BA reads is the step's own
+            wait_on_dependent_grids()
+        rows = []
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(T):
+            rows.append((bos + cutlass.min(INT32(t), ntok - 1)).to(INT64) * HIDDEN)
+        # the hidden pieces, one FLAT list per virtual thread indexed c * T + t: a nested subscript store (hx[c][t] = ...) would mark
+        # every name of its inner index as written in this dynamic region and the DSL would hand P back as a traced value
+        hx0 = [None] * (BA_CHUNKS * T)
+        hx1 = [None] * (BA_CHUNKS * T)
+        bd0, ad0, bd1, ad1 = [], [], [], []
+        for _ in cutlass.range_constexpr(T):
+            bd0.append(FP32(0))
+            ad0.append(FP32(0))
+            bd1.append(FP32(0))
+            ad1.append(FP32(0))
+        # the hidden rows: chunks 0 .. P - 1 in flight at once, the rest issued as a chunk's chains complete
+        for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(P):
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(T):
+                hx0[c * T + t] = ld_global_v4(_gaddr(hidden, rows[t] + c * BA_CHUNK + u * 8), INT32)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(c < BA_CHUNKS - 1):
+                    hx1[c * T + t] = ld_global_v4(_gaddr(hidden, rows[t] + c * BA_CHUNK + WARPGROUP * 8 + u * 8), INT32)
+        for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(BA_CHUNKS):
+            b0, a0, b1, a1 = [], [], [], []
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                b0.extend(_unpack_bf16x2(bw0[c][j]))
+                a0.extend(_unpack_bf16x2(aw0[c][j]))
+                if cutlass.const_expr(c < BA_CHUNKS - 1):
+                    b1.extend(_unpack_bf16x2(bw1[c][j]))
+                    a1.extend(_unpack_bf16x2(aw1[c][j]))
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(T):
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    hlo, hhi = _unpack_bf16x2(hx0[c * T + t][j])
+                    bd0[t] = bd0[t] + hlo * b0[2 * j]
+                    bd0[t] = bd0[t] + hhi * b0[2 * j + 1]
+                    ad0[t] = ad0[t] + hlo * a0[2 * j]
+                    ad0[t] = ad0[t] + hhi * a0[2 * j + 1]
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(c < BA_CHUNKS - 1):
+                        glo, ghi = _unpack_bf16x2(hx1[c * T + t][j])
+                        bd1[t] = bd1[t] + glo * b1[2 * j]
+                        bd1[t] = bd1[t] + ghi * b1[2 * j + 1]
+                        ad1[t] = ad1[t] + glo * a1[2 * j]
+                        ad1[t] = ad1[t] + ghi * a1[2 * j + 1]
+            if cutlass.const_expr(c + P < BA_CHUNKS):
+                for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(T):
+                    hx0[(c + P) * T + t] = ld_global_v4(_gaddr(hidden, rows[t] + (c + P) * BA_CHUNK + u * 8), INT32)
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(c + P < BA_CHUNKS - 1):
+                        hx1[(c + P) * T + t] = ld_global_v4(_gaddr(hidden, rows[t] + (c + P) * BA_CHUNK + WARPGROUP * 8 + u * 8), INT32)
+        # one 5-step butterfly per (virtual warp, token): virtual warps wl (thread u) and wl + 4 (thread u + 128) pair the same lanes
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(T):
+            for step in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+                bd0[t] = bd0[t] + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(bd0[t], offset=1 << step)
+                ad0[t] = ad0[t] + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(ad0[t], offset=1 << step)
+                bd1[t] = bd1[t] + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(bd1[t], offset=1 << step)
+                ad1[t] = ad1[t] + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(ad1[t], offset=1 << step)
+            if lane == 0:
+                ba_part[(wl * T + t) * 2] = bd0[t]
+                ba_part[(wl * T + t) * 2 + 1] = ad0[t]
+                ba_part[((wl + 4) * T + t) * 2] = bd1[t]
+                ba_part[((wl + 4) * T + t) * 2 + 1] = ad1[t]
+        _wg_barrier(2)
+        if u < 2 * T:
+            # thread 2 t: token t's b -> beta; thread 2 t + 1: its a -> decay (the reference's thread roles and summation order)
+            total = FP32(0)
+            for wi in cutlass.range_constexpr(WARPS):
+                total = total + ba_part[wi * 2 * T + u]
+            gv = total.to(BF16).to(FP32)
+            tok = u // 2
+            if u % 2 == 0:
+                scal_s[4 * tok + 1] = FP32(1) / (FP32(1) + cute.math.exp(-gv))
+                if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.DEBUG):
+                    baout[(bos + cutlass.min(tok, ntok - 1)).to(INT64) * (2 * V_HEADS) + head] = gv.to(BF16)
+            else:
+                gx = gv + dtv
+                soft = gx
+                if gx <= FP32(SOFTPLUS_LINEAR_ABOVE):
+                    soft = cute.math.log(FP32(1) + cute.math.exp(gx))
+                scal_s[4 * tok] = cute.math.exp(-cute.math.exp(alv) * soft)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.DEBUG):
+                    baout[(bos + cutlass.min(tok, ntok - 1)).to(INT64) * (2 * V_HEADS) + head + V_HEADS] = gv.to(BF16)
+

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# the conv role (warpgroup 1): the conv-operand mbarrier + copies, the ticket, T tokens of conv + SiLU, the RMS scales, the staging
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+@cute.jit
+def _conv_role(
+    cfg: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    tid,
+    head,
+    kh,
+    n,
+    bos,
+    ntok,
+    live,
+    cv_slot,
+    acc,
+    qkv,
+    cs,
+    cw,
+    counts,
+    x_s,
+    cw_s,
+    hist_s,
+    qk_raw,
+    q_s,
+    k_s,
+    v_s,
+    scal_s,
+    ticket_s,
+    mb_arr,
+    convout,
+    XS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CSS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CST: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    T: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    C = cfg.C
+    PITCH = cfg.SLICE_PITCH
+    RMS_ROUNDS = (T + WARPGROUP // RMS_LANES - 1) // (WARPGROUP // RMS_LANES)
+    u = tid - WARPGROUP  # 0 .. 127: the channel this thread convolves in each piece
+    wl = u // 32
+    lane = tid % 32
+    hw = u // RMS_LANES  # the half-warp (0 .. 7): one token per RMS round
+    l16 = u % RMS_LANES  # the RMS lane: columns 8 l16 .. 8 l16 + 7
+    if wl == 0:
+        if lane == 0:
+            nvvm.mbarrier_init(mb_arr, CONV_MBAR_ARRIVERS)
+            nvvm.fence_mbarrier_init()
+    _wg_barrier(1)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD):
+        nvvm.barrier_cluster_arrive_relaxed()  # P4 step 3 for this warpgroup's 128 threads (the wait sits in the tail)
+    if live:
+        rows = []
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(T):
+            rows.append((bos + cutlass.min(INT32(t), ntok - 1)).to(INT64))
+        if lane == 0:
+            # warp 4 arms the operand bytes once and issues the weights + history; token t's input rows by warp 5 + t mod 3 (spread)
+            if wl == 0:
+                nvvm.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(mb_arr, conv_bulk_bytes(T))
+                _issue_conv_param_copies(cw, cs, cw_s, hist_s, mb_arr, head, kh, cv_slot, (acc - 1).to(INT64), CSS, CST)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(not cfg.PDL):
+                for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(T):
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.SPREAD_ISSUE):
+                        if wl == 1 + t % 3:
+                            _issue_conv_x_copies(qkv, x_s, mb_arr, rows[t], head, kh, XS, t)
+                    else:
+                        if wl == 0:
+                            _issue_conv_x_copies(qkv, x_s, mb_arr, rows[t], head, kh, XS, t)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.PDL):
+            # the QKVZ projection's rows are read only past this point
+            wait_on_dependent_grids()
+            if lane == 0:
+                for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(T):
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.SPREAD_ISSUE):
+                        if wl == 1 + t % 3:
+                            _issue_conv_x_copies(qkv, x_s, mb_arr, rows[t], head, kh, XS, t)
+                    else:
+                        if wl == 0:
+                            _issue_conv_x_copies(qkv, x_s, mb_arr, rows[t], head, kh, XS, t)
+        wait(mb_arr, 0)
+        if wl == 0:
+            if lane == 0:
+                # every history byte of this CTA has landed: the ticket orders this CTA's reads before the last reader's shift
+                ticket_s[0] = _atom_inc_relaxed_gpu(_gaddr(counts, n * TICKET_STRIDE + kh * 32), INT32(cfg.TICKET_LIMIT))
+        taps = []
+        for piece in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+            tp = []
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(CONV_WIDTH):
+                tp.append(cw_s[piece * HEAD_DIM * CONV_WIDTH + u * CONV_WIDTH + e].to(FP32))
+            taps.append(tp)
+        # the permuted index of head row u (the RG lanes of a phase read consecutive words; a two-CTA pair reads disjoint halves)
+        vperm = (u % cfg.BOX_ROWS) * cfg.V_PERM_STRIDE + u // cfg.BOX_ROWS
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(T):
+            qval = _conv_value(x_s, hist_s, taps[0], t, 0, u)
+            kval = _conv_value(x_s, hist_s, taps[1], t, 1, u)
+            vval = _conv_value(x_s, hist_s, taps[2], t, 2, u)
+            qk_raw[t * 2 * HEAD_DIM + u] = qval
+            qk_raw[t * 2 * HEAD_DIM + HEAD_DIM + u] = kval
+            v_s[t * HEAD_DIM + vperm] = vval
+            if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.DEBUG):
+                if ntok > t:
+                    convout[rows[t] * QKV_CHANNELS + V_CHANNEL0 + head * HEAD_DIM + u] = vval.to(BF16)
+                    if head % 3 == 0:
+                        convout[rows[t] * QKV_CHANNELS + kh * HEAD_DIM + u] = qval.to(BF16)
+                        convout[rows[t] * QKV_CHANNELS + K_CHANNEL0 + kh * HEAD_DIM + u] = kval.to(BF16)
+        _wg_barrier(1)
+        # the per-token RMS scales: half-warp hw reduces token 8 r + hw as the reference's half-warps do (same lanes, same butterfly),
+        # then writes that token's SCALED q / k slices (lanes past the last token compute a duplicate and store nothing)
+        qk_base = _smem_addr(qk_raw)
+        q_base = _smem_addr(q_s)
+        k_base = _smem_addr(k_s)
+        sl_off = (8 * l16 // C) * PITCH + (8 * l16 % C)  # the slice position of columns 8 l16 .. 8 l16 + 7
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(RMS_ROUNDS):
+            pt = cutlass.min(INT32(r * (WARPGROUP // RMS_LANES)) + hw, INT32(T - 1))
+            qv = _slice_values(qk_base + (pt * 2 * HEAD_DIM + RMS_COLS * l16) * 4, RMS_COLS)
+            kv = _slice_values(qk_base + (pt * 2 * HEAD_DIM + HEAD_DIM + RMS_COLS * l16) * 4, RMS_COLS)
+            qs = FP32(0)
+            ks = FP32(0)
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(RMS_COLS):
+                qs = qs + qv[j] * qv[j]
+                ks = ks + kv[j] * kv[j]
+            for step in cutlass.range_constexpr(RMS_LANES.bit_length() - 1):
+                qs = qs + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(qs, offset=1 << step)
+                ks = ks + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(ks, offset=1 << step)
+            qscale = FP32(Q_SCALE) / cute.math.sqrt(qs + FP32(RMS_EPS))
+            kscale = FP32(1) / cute.math.sqrt(ks + FP32(RMS_EPS))
+            if INT32(r * (WARPGROUP // RMS_LANES)) + hw < INT32(T):
+                qsc = []
+                ksc = []
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(RMS_COLS):
+                    qsc.append(qv[j] * qscale)
+                    ksc.append(kv[j] * kscale)
+                _store_slice(q_base + (pt * cfg.TPR * PITCH + sl_off) * 4, qsc)
+                _store_slice(k_base + (pt * cfg.TPR * PITCH + sl_off) * 4, ksc)
+                if l16 == 0:
+                    scal_s[4 * pt + 2] = qscale
+                    scal_s[4 * pt + 3] = kscale
+

+@cute.jit
+def _token_step_rolled(
+    cfg: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    t,
+    S_rows,
+    c_prev2,
+    tid,
+    head,
+    r,
+    n,
+    bos,
+    ntok,
+    orow,
+    rowbase,
+    rowbase_cta,
+    col0,
+    vbase,
+    tpr,
+    warp,
+    lane,
+    slice_base,
+    k_base0,
+    q_base0,
+    recv_base,
+    peer,
+    wv,
+    scv,
+    zv,
+    state,
+    indices,
+    out,
+    qout,
+    raw,
+    q_s,
+    k_s,
+    v_s,
+    scal_s,
+    o_s,
+    inv_s,
+    norm_recv_s,
+    mb_norm,
+    ring,
+    SS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    IS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    EPS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    """One token of the ROLLED loop (a DYNAMIC ``t``): the body of the unrolled loop with every per-token address computed from ``t``, the
+    deferred norm (``t >= 1``) and outputs (``t >= 2``: the core values of token ``t - 2`` = ``c_prev2``) under uniform predicates.
+    Returns the updated row registers and this token's core values."""
+    TPR = cfg.TPR
+    R = cfg.R
+    C = cfg.C
+    RG = cfg.RG
+    NBUF = cfg.NBUF
+    PITCH = cfg.SLICE_PITCH
+    TWO = cfg.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD
+    NCH = cfg.NORM_CHAINS_CTA
+    tm1 = t - 1
+    dst_buf = t % NBUF
+    dst_base = slice_base + dst_buf * (cfg.SLAB_SMEM_ELEMS * 4)
+    decay = scal_s[4 * t]
+    beta = scal_s[4 * t + 1]
+    k_base = k_base0 + t * (TPR * PITCH * 4)
+    q_base = q_base0 + t * (TPR * PITCH * 4)
+    ss_prev = FP32(0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(TWO):
+        if t >= 1:
+            if warp == NORM_WARP:
+                ss_prev = _norm_chain_sum(cfg, o_s, tm1 % 2, lane)
+                if lane == 0:
+                    nvvm.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(mb_norm.subview(tm1 % 2), cfg.NORM_XFER_BYTES)
+                if lane < NCH:
+                    _st_async_f32(
+                        _mapa_u32(recv_base + ((tm1 % 2) * NORM_RECV_MAX_FLOATS + lane) * 4, peer),
+                        ss_prev,
+                        _mapa_u32(_smem_addr(mb_norm) + (tm1 % 2) * 8, peer),
+                    )
+    k = _slice_values(k_base, C) if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.K_RESIDENT) else None
+    h_rows, dots = _pass1(cfg, S_rows, slice_base, k, k_base, decay)
+    inn = []
+    for m in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+        inn.append((v_s[t * HEAD_DIM + vbase + m * cfg.V_PERM_STRIDE] - dots[m]) * beta)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.BULK_STORE and NBUF == 1):
+        if t >= 1:
+            if lane == 0:
+                nvvm.cp_async_bulk_wait_group(0, read=True)
+            _cta_barrier()
+    S_new, values = _pass2(cfg, h_rows, slice_base, dst_base, k, k_base, q_base, inn, decay, cfg.BULK_STORE)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(not cfg.BULK_STORE):
+        dst_stg = indices[n * IS + t].to(INT64)
+        if ntok > t:
+            if dst_stg > 0:
+                for m in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+                    _store_row_gmem(state, dst_stg, head, rowbase + m, col0, S_new[m], SS)
+    if tpr == 0:
+        for m in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+            o_s[(t % 2) * HEAD_DIM + rowbase_cta + m] = values[m]
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.BULK_STORE):
+        cute.arch.fence_view_async_shared()
+    if t >= 1:
+        if warp == NORM_WARP:
+            if cutlass.const_expr(TWO):
+                wait(mb_norm.subview(tm1 % 2), (tm1 >> 1) & 1)
+                inv_prev = _norm_inverse_pair(cfg, ss_prev, norm_recv_s[(tm1 % 2) * NORM_RECV_MAX_FLOATS + lane % NCH], r, lane, EPS)
+            else:
+                inv_prev = _norm_inverse(cfg, o_s, tm1 % 2, lane, EPS)
+            if lane == 0:
+                inv_s[tm1 % 2] = inv_prev
+    if t >= 2:
+        if tpr < R:
+            if ntok > t - 2:
+                oi = (bos + (t - 2)).to(INT64) * OUT_ROW + head * HEAD_DIM + orow
+                _emit_output(cfg, c_prev2, tpr, inv_s[(t - 2) % 2], wv, _pick_dyn(zv, t - 2), scv, oi, out, qout, raw)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.BULK_STORE and NBUF >= 2):
+        if lane == 0:
+            nvvm.cp_async_bulk_wait_group(NBUF - 2, read=True)
+    _cta_barrier()
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.BULK_STORE):
+        if lane == 0:
+            dst = indices[n * IS + t].to(INT64)
+            if ntok > t:
+                if dst > 0:
+                    for b in cutlass.range_constexpr(RG):
+                        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.SPREAD_ISSUE):
+                            if warp == b % WARPS:
+                                _issue_state_store_box(cfg, state, ring, dst_buf, dst, head, r, SS, b)
+                        else:
+                            if warp == 0:
+                                _issue_state_store_box(cfg, state, ring, dst_buf, dst, head, r, SS, b)
+            nvvm.cp_async_bulk_commit_group()
+    return S_new, values
+

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# the role-independent tail (traced once): the hand-off, the slab, the T tokens, the deferred norm / outputs, the shift, the drain
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+@cute.jit
+def _tail_live(
+    cfg: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    tid,
+    head,
+    r,
+    kh,
+    n,
+    bos,
+    ntok,
+    cv_slot,
+    state,
+    indices,
+    z,
+    w,
+    scale,
+    out,
+    qout,
+    cs,
+    raw,
+    x_s,
+    hist_s,
+    q_s,
+    k_s,
+    v_s,
+    scal_s,
+    o_s,
+    inv_s,
+    norm_recv_s,
+    ticket_s,
+    mb_state,
+    mb_norm,
+    ring,
+    ZS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    SS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    IS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CSS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CST: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    EPS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    T: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    TPR = cfg.TPR
+    R = cfg.R
+    C = cfg.C
+    RG = cfg.RG
+    NBUF = cfg.NBUF
+    PITCH = cfg.SLICE_PITCH
+    TWO = cfg.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD
+    NCH = cfg.NORM_CHAINS_CTA
+    warp = tid // 32
+    lane = tid % 32
+    tpr = lane // RG
+    rg = lane % RG
+    rowbase_cta = cfg.BOX_ROWS * rg + R * warp  # this CTA's row (0 .. CTA_ROWS - 1): the o_s index and the box row
+    rowbase = (cfg.CTA_ROWS * r + rowbase_cta) if TWO else rowbase_cta  # the head row (the one-CTA form adds nothing: its arithmetic is the committed one)
+    col0 = tpr * C
+    orow = rowbase + cutlass.min(tpr, R - 1)  # the row this thread outputs (the tpr < R threads each take one of the row group's R rows)
+    vbase = ((R * warp) * cfg.V_PERM_STRIDE + r * RG + rg) if TWO else (R * warp) * RG + rg  # v_s index of row rowbase (+ m V_PERM_STRIDE)
+    slice_base = _smem_addr(ring) + rg * (cfg.STATE_BOX_PITCH_ELEMS * 4) + (R * warp) * ROW_BYTES + col0 * 4  # in ring buffer 0
+    q_base0 = _smem_addr(q_s) + tpr * (PITCH * 4)

+def _spec(device=CPU, rows=2, param_dtypes=(F32, BF16, BF16), form="decode", tokens=1):
+    """A plan spec; for ``verify`` ``rows`` is the requests count and ``tokens`` the tokens per request."""
+    return fi_api.Qwen35GdnPlanSpec(backend.BACKEND, form, rows, tokens, GEOMETRY, torch.device(device), tuple(param_dtypes))

+def _tensors(rows, device, slots=None, seed=0):
+    """One decode call's tensors in FlashInfer's serving layout: ``qkv`` / ``z`` views of one QKVZ slab, the conv pool channel-innermost
+    (``[slots, 3, C]`` transposed to the ``[slots, C, 3]`` view), the kernel-native parameter dtypes."""
+    slots = rows + 1 if slots is None else slots
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+
+    def rn(*shape):
+        return torch.randn(*shape, generator=g).to(device)
+
+    qkvz = (rn(rows, 16384) * 2).bfloat16()
+    return dict(
+        qkv=qkvz[:, :10240],
+        z=qkvz[:, 10240:].view(rows, 48, 128),
+        hidden=rn(rows, 5120).bfloat16(),
+        ba_weight=(rn(96, 5120) / 5120**0.5).bfloat16(),
+        A_log=rn(48) * 0.5,
+        dt_bias=(rn(48) * 0.5).bfloat16(),
+        ssm_state=rn(slots, 48, 128, 128) * 0.1,
+        state_indices=torch.arange(1, rows + 1, dtype=torch.int32).to(device),
+        norm_weight=(1 + 0.2 * rn(128)).bfloat16(),
+        out_scale=torch.tensor([0.02], device=device),
+        conv_state=rn(slots, 3, 10240).bfloat16().transpose(1, 2),
+        conv_weight=(0.3 * rn(10240, 4)).bfloat16(),
+        out=torch.empty(rows, 48, 128, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device=device),
+    )
+
+
+def _verify_tensors(requests, tokens, device, seed=0):
+    """One verify call's tensors in FlashInfer's layout: ``state_indices`` ``[requests, T]``, the conv pool channel-innermost (``[slots, T + 2,
+    C]`` transposed to the ``[slots, C, T + 2]`` view), ``cu_seqlens`` / ``num_accepted_tokens`` int32, every request fully accepted."""
+    rows = requests * tokens
+    t = _tensors(rows, device, slots=rows + 1, seed=seed)
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed + 1)
+    t["conv_state"] = torch.randn(rows + 1, tokens + 2, 10240, generator=g).to(device).bfloat16().transpose(1, 2)
+    t["state_indices"] = torch.arange(1, rows + 1, dtype=torch.int32).view(requests, tokens).to(device)
+    t["cu_seqlens"] = torch.arange(0, rows + 1, tokens, dtype=torch.int32).to(device)
+    t["num_accepted_tokens"] = torch.full((requests,), tokens, dtype=torch.int32).to(device)
+    return t
+

+def _sm100_verify_form(device, requests=None, norm_eps=1e-6):
+    """The verify form a cc 10.0 part with 148 SMs picks, for a host without one: the entry's pick with that part's readings (no requests
+    count = the pick at one request, as the backend reads it)."""
+    cfg = kvcfg.default_cfg(1 if requests is None else int(requests), SM100_SMS)
+    return kvcfg.resolve_cfg(replace(cfg, **SM100_READINGS), 1 if requests is None else int(requests))

+def test_runner_launch_re_checks_the_binding():
+    """FlashInfer's ``bind_inputs`` checks dtypes and shapes; the entries re-check the whole binding (alignment and layout too) on every
+    launch, before the compiled kernel sees the pointers: with a kernel planted under the binding's compile key, a misaligned operand is a
+    typed decline at ``run``, never a launch -- on both runners."""
+
+    def launched(*args):
+        raise AssertionError("the planted kernel was launched on a mismatched binding")
+
+    spec = _spec(rows=2)
+    x = fi_api.bind_inputs(spec, **_tensors(2, CPU))
+    runner = backend.FrostFeDecodeRunner(spec)
+    args = runner._args(x)
+    runner.kernel.compiled[runner.kernel.key(args[0], args[1], args[2], args[6], args[8])] = launched
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="norm weight|aligned"):
+        runner.run(replace(x, norm_weight=torch.ones(136, dtype=BF16)[1:129]))  # the right dtype and shape at a 2-byte offset
+    vspec = _spec(form="verify", rows=2, tokens=4)
+    vx = fi_api.bind_inputs(vspec, **_verify_tensors(2, 4, CPU))

+layers, a loose torch reference of the fused math, and the bitwise agreement of every knob arm (the shared-memory state path, the
+streamed two-CTAs-per-SM form, the PDL order, the TPR mappings, the 128-thread form, the tap-contiguous conv-state layout) with the
+entry's default pick on one operand set that carries a null row and non-monotone slots.  The default's per-rows pick (one CTA per
+SM while the rows x 48 grid fits the SMs, the streamed two-CTAs-per-SM form past that) is pinned on the host for two SM counts and

+# the cc 10.0 part reading (228 KB per SM, 227 KB opt-in) and a hypothetical larger part (336 KiB per SM, 335 KiB opt-in): the pad must do

+def make_operands(rows=ROWS, device="cpu", slots=SLOTS, seed=0, **overrides):
+    """The entry's operand set in the serving layout (x = the QKV part of a [rows, 16384] slab, z its Z part viewed [rows, 48, 128],
+    cs the [slots, 3, 10240] conv buffer transposed to [slots, 10240, 3])."""
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+
+    def rn(*shape):
+        return torch.randn(*shape, generator=g).to(device)
+
+    qkvz = (rn(rows, 16384) * 2).bfloat16()
+    conv = rn(slots, 3, 10240).bfloat16()
+    ops = dict(
+        rows=rows,
+        x=qkvz[:, :10240],
+        cs=conv.transpose(-1, -2),
+        cw=(0.3 * rn(10240, 4)).bfloat16(),
+        al=rn(48) * 0.5,
+        dt=(rn(48) * 0.5).bfloat16(),
+        state=rn(slots, 48, 128, 128) * 0.1,
+        idx=torch.arange(1, rows + 1, dtype=torch.int32).to(device),
+        z=qkvz[:, 10240:].view(rows, 48, 128),
+        w=(1 + 0.2 * rn(128)).bfloat16(),
+        scale=torch.tensor([0.02]).to(device),
+        hidden=rn(rows, 5120).bfloat16(),
+        baw=(rn(96, 5120) / math.sqrt(5120)).bfloat16(),
+    )
+    ops.update(overrides)
+    return ops

+    return tuple(ops[name] for name in ("rows", "x", "cs", "cw", "al", "dt", "state", "idx", "z", "w", "scale", "hidden", "baw"))

+def test_state_box_bank_map_is_conflict_free_at_every_tpr():
+    """The 8 lanes of a 128-bit shared-memory phase read 8 distinct bank quads: bank = 4 rg + (128 / TPR) tpr + 4 c4 (mod 32)."""
+    forms = [(256, tpr, False) for tpr in (2, 4, 8, 16)] + [(128, 1, False)] + [(256, tpr, True) for tpr in (4, 8, 16)] + [(128, 2, True)]
+    for threads, tpr, two in forms:
+        c = kcfg.make_cfg(THREADS=threads, TPR=tpr, WARPGROUP_SPLIT=threads == 256, STATE_LOAD_PATH="bulk", TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD=two)
+        pitch_words = c.STATE_BOX_PITCH_ELEMS
+        for c4 in range(c.C // 4):
+            for m in range(c.R):
+                for phase in range(4):
+                    quads = set()
+                    for lane in range(8 * phase, 8 * phase + 8):
+                        tp, rg = lane // c.RG, lane % c.RG
+                        word = rg * pitch_words + (c.R * 0 + m) * 128 + tp * c.C + 4 * c4  # warp 0; the warp term is a multiple of 32
+                        quads.add((word % 32) // 4)
+                    assert len(quads) == 8, (threads, tpr, two, c4, m, phase, sorted(quads))

+def test_every_launch_re_checks_the_binding():
+    """A compiled DSL entry accepts a tensor of another dtype or footprint silently, so the entry re-runs the binding checks on every
+    launch, before the compiled kernel sees the pointers: with a kernel planted under the binding's compile key (rows, strides, the
+    config -- none of these mutations changes it), a mismatched operand is a typed decline, never a launch."""
+    k = entry.GdnDecodeFused("cpu", 1e-6)
+    ops = make_operands()
+    key = k.key(ROWS, ops["x"], ops["cs"], ops["state"], ops["z"])
+
+    def launched(*args):
+        raise AssertionError("the planted kernel was launched on a mismatched binding")
+
+    k.compiled[key] = launched
+    for mutation, exc, token in (
+        (dict(hidden=ops["hidden"].to(torch.float16)), TypeError, "hidden"),  # a dtype the key does not carry
+        (dict(idx=ops["idx"][:1]), ValueError, "idx"),  # fewer slots than rows
+        (dict(w=torch.ones(128 + 8, dtype=torch.bfloat16)[1:129]), ValueError, "w"),  # the right shape at a 2-byte offset: misaligned
+        (dict(cw=torch.zeros(10240, 3, dtype=torch.bfloat16)), NotImplementedError, "conv weight"),
+        (dict(state=ops["state"].cpu().to("meta")), ValueError, "one device"),
+    ):
+        bad = dict(ops, **mutation)
+        assert k.key(ROWS, bad["x"], bad["cs"], bad["state"], bad["z"]) == key, "the mutation keeps the compile key: only the launch check sees it"
+        with pytest.raises(exc, match=token):

+def _device_or_skip():
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        pytest.skip("needs a CUDA device")
+    cc = tuple(torch.cuda.get_device_capability())
+    if not entry.cc_supported(cc):
+        pytest.skip(f"the fused GDN decode step serves SM100-class parts (cc 10.x), this device is {cc}")
+    msg = entry._dsl_version_error()
+    if msg:
+        pytest.skip(msg)
+    return torch.device("cuda")

+def _run(k, ops):
+    return k(*_binding_args(ops))
+
+
+def _reference(ops, eps=1e-6):
+    """A plain torch (fp32 / fp64) model of the fused math; the kernel rounds exactly where the serving chain rounds (BA in bf16,
+    the conv taps and SiLU in bf16, the core output in bf16, the normed value in bf16), the model's SiLU and transcendental forms
+    are torch's -- so the comparison is loose, a function check, never a bit check."""
+    rows = ops["rows"]
+    x, cs, cw, al, dt, st, idx, z, w, scale, hid, baw = (ops[k] for k in ("x", "cs", "cw", "al", "dt", "state", "idx", "z", "w", "scale", "hidden", "baw"))
+    out = torch.zeros(rows, 48, 128, dtype=torch.float64, device=x.device)
+    state_new = st.clone()
+    cs_new = cs.clone()
+    for b in range(rows):
+        slot = int(idx[b])
+        if slot <= 0:
+            continue
+        taps = cs[slot].float()  # [10240, 3]
+        xb = x[b].float()
+        acc = torch.zeros(10240, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+        for j in range(3):
+            acc = acc + (taps[:, j] * cw[:, j].float()).bfloat16().float()
+        acc = acc + (xb * cw[:, 3].float()).bfloat16().float()
+        conv = torch.nn.functional.silu(acc).bfloat16().float()
+        cs_new[slot, :, 0] = cs[slot, :, 1]
+        cs_new[slot, :, 1] = cs[slot, :, 2]
+        cs_new[slot, :, 2] = x[b]
+        for h in range(48):
+            kh = h // 3
+            bval = (hid[b].float() @ baw[h].float()).bfloat16().float()
+            aval = (hid[b].float() @ baw[48 + h].float()).bfloat16().float()
+            av = aval + dt[h].float()
+            soft = torch.nn.functional.softplus(av) if float(av) <= 20 else av
+            decay = torch.exp(-torch.exp(al[h]) * soft)
+            beta = torch.sigmoid(bval)
+            q = conv[kh * 128 : (kh + 1) * 128]
+            k_ = conv[2048 + kh * 128 : 2048 + (kh + 1) * 128]
+            v = conv[4096 + h * 128 : 4096 + (h + 1) * 128]
+            q = q * (128**-0.5 / torch.sqrt((q * q).sum() + 1e-6))
+            k_ = k_ / torch.sqrt((k_ * k_).sum() + 1e-6)
+            S = st[slot, h].double() * decay.double()
+            dot = S @ k_.double()
+            inn = (v.double() - dot) * beta.double()
+            S = S + torch.outer(inn, k_.double())
+            state_new[slot, h] = S.float()
+            o = (S @ q.double()).float().bfloat16().float()
+            inv = torch.rsqrt((o * o).mean() + eps)
+            gate = z[b, h].float()
+            out[b, h] = ((o * inv) * w.float() * (gate / (1 + torch.exp(-gate)))).bfloat16().double()
+    return out, state_new, cs_new
+
