+                          which every waiter passes after the initialising thread's own arrival there); one ``arrive.expect_tx(65536)`` by
+                          the same lane (under ``CONV_FIRST`` right AFTER its conv-operand copies); the RG box copies complete the bytes;
+                          waited by every thread (phase 0) after the first ``bar.sync 0``.
+  ``barrier.sync 1, 128``  (non-aligned) the conv warpgroup, twice: after the mbarrier init (visibility), after the raw q / k smem writes.
+  ``barrier.sync 2, 128``  (non-aligned) the BA warpgroup, once: the four warps' BA partials before the totals (twice with the ldg128 pin knob).
+  ``barrier.sync 0, 256`` (non-aligned) twice: {q, k, v, decay, beta, ticket} published; the norm partials published (and, bulk, every thread's
+                          STS + ``fence.proxy.async`` of the updated rows before the one lane's bulk stores read them).
+  bulk store               RG ``cp.async.bulk.global.shared::cta.bulk_group`` + ``commit_group`` by thread 0 after ``bar.sync 0`` #2;
+                          the same thread's ``wait_group.read 0`` is its last instruction (the smem is read out before the CTA
+                          retires; the global writes complete with the grid).  ``STORE_PIPELINE``: each warpgroup's warp-0 lane 0
+                          instead issues the RG half-box stores of its warpgroup's rows right after warp 0's ``barrier.sync {2 | 1}, 128``
+                          (warps 1-3 ``barrier.arrive``, 96 + 32 = 128: the warpgroup's STS + proxy fences published to it; whole warps
+                          participate, no intra-warp divergence at a barrier), and each of the two lanes drains its own group before exit.
+  ticket                   one ``atom.relaxed.gpu.inc`` after the mbarrier wait (all history bytes read); consumed at exit.
+  PDL (knob)               ``griddepcontrol.wait`` by every thread in both slot arms, after the predecessor-independent loads and
+                          issues (slot, parameters, BA weights, the state slab, the conv weights and history) and before ``z``,
+                          ``hidden``, the ``x`` copies and every global write; ``launch_dependents`` at entry under ``PDL_RELEASE``.
+                          CALLER OBLIGATION: the kernel immediately preceding this launch in the stream must not write this layer's
+                          ``state``, ``cs`` or ``indices`` -- the pre-wait loads read them before the wait, so a predecessor that writes
+                          them (the same layer launched twice in a row) races the slab boxes / history copies against its stores and
+                          its write-back: a wrong state, no error.  The serving chain's predecessor (the QKVZ projection) writes only
+                          ``x`` / ``z``, which are read after the wait; the host entry cannot check the obligation.
+  null slot                no arrive, nothing in flight at exit.
+
+Numerics: the reference kernel's arithmetic order and PTX forms (the reference kernel: FlashInfer's built-in ``frost`` decode backend for
+the Qwen 3.5 GDN block; every product that feeds an add is single-use where the reference
+fuses and multi-use where it does not; the norm squares are explicit ``mul.rn.f32``), so the fp32 state, the conv state, the bf16
+``out`` and the fp8 ``qout`` are bitwise with it under every knob: the thread mapping moves the tree's leaves between threads, never its
+association (the in-thread groups are contiguous 8-column groups combined in order; the xor steps pair the same partials; the norm's
+``RG x WARPS`` partials are aligned blocks of consecutive rows combined in row order).
+
+Shared memory (bytes; no swizzle: no descriptor reads these buffers, every per-lane pitch that could hit one bank is padded): x pieces
+768, conv weights 3072, conv history 2304, raw q / k 1024, q / k slices 2 x TPR x (C + 4) x 4 (the slices of a phase land in distinct
+banks), v 512 (index-permuted so the RG lanes of a phase read consecutive words), scalars 16, ticket 16, BA partials 32, norm partials
+RG x WARPS x 4, the two mbarriers 16 + 16, the state buffer RG boxes x (BOX_ROWS x 512 + 16) B (bulk; 16 B otherwise: box pitch
+padded by one 16-B chunk -> bank = 4 rg + (128 / TPR) tpr + 4 c4 mod 32, eight distinct quads per 8-lane phase at every TPR), plus the
+occupancy pad of ``Cfg.CTAS_PER_SM`` derived from the device's shared memory per SM.
+"""
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import cutlass.experimental.primitives as nvvm
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import arith
+
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.barrier import launch_dependent_grids, wait, wait_on_dependent_grids
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.tma import ld_global_v4, ld_shared_v4, st_global_v4, st_shared_v4
+
+from .gdn_decode_fused_config import (
+    BA_CHUNKS,
+    CONV_BULK_BYTES,
+    CONV_MBAR_ARRIVERS,
+    CONV_WIDTH,
+    HEAD_DIM,
+    HIDDEN,
+    K_CHANNEL0,
+    NORM_MBAR_ARRIVERS,
+    NORM_XFER_BYTES,
+    QKV_CHANNELS,
+    RMS_LANES,
+    STATE_MBAR_ARRIVERS,
+    TICKET_STRIDE,
+    V_CHANNEL0,
+    V_HEADS,
+)
+
+FP32 = cutlass.Float32
+BF16 = cutlass.BFloat16
+INT32 = cutlass.Int32
+INT64 = cutlass.Int64
+UINT8 = cutlass.Uint8
+
+# the reference's q scale constant 128 ** -0.5 (its fp32 literal), the RMS epsilon and the softplus threshold
+Q_SCALE = 0.08838834764831845
+RMS_EPS = 1e-6
+SOFTPLUS_LINEAR_ABOVE = 20.0
+RMS_COLS = HEAD_DIM // RMS_LANES  # 8 raw values per RMS lane
+ROW_BYTES = HEAD_DIM * 4  # one state row in the shared-memory boxes (the natural 512-B pitch inside a box)
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# PTX forms shared with the reference kernel (inline PTX through the DSL primitive; outputs number first, inputs after)
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _unpack_bf16x2(word):
+    """A bf16x2 word -> (lo, hi) as fp32: ``shl 16`` / ``and 0xffff0000`` (the reference helper's exact ``* 1.0`` dropped)."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx(
+        "{\n\t.reg .b32 t;\n\tshl.b32 t, $2, 16;\n\tmov.b32 $0, t;\n\tand.b32 t, $2, 0xffff0000;\n\tmov.b32 $1, t;\n\t}",
+        write_only_types=[FP32, FP32],
+        read_only_args=[word],
+    )
+
+
+def _stock_conv_silu(value):
+    """The stock causal-conv SiLU: ``x / (1 + ex2(-x * log2 e))`` with ``ex2.approx`` and ``div.full``."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx(
+        "{\n\t.reg .f32 t, e, d;\n\tmul.f32 t, $1, 0fBFB8AA3B;\n\tex2.approx.f32 e, t;\n\tadd.f32 d, e, 0f3F800000;\n\tdiv.full.f32 $0, $1, d;\n\t}",
+        write_only_types=[FP32],
+        read_only_args=[value],
+    )
+
+
+def _quant_fp8_word(value, scale):
+    """The stock per-tensor FP8 quantization: ``v * (1 / scale)`` with a ``div.rn`` reciprocal, ``cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2``; the
+    e4m3 byte is the low byte of the returned word."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx(
+        "{\n\t.reg .f32 inv, v;\n\t.reg .b16 p;\n\tdiv.rn.f32 inv, 0f3F800000, $2;\n\tmul.f32 v, $1, inv;\n\t"
+        "cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2.f32 p, 0f00000000, v;\n\tcvt.u32.u16 $0, p;\n\t}",
+        write_only_types=[INT32],
+        read_only_args=[value, scale],
+    )
+
+
+def _mul_rn_f32(a, b):
+    """An fp32 product the compiler cannot fuse into a following add (the reference's norm squares are unfused ``FMUL``)."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx("mul.rn.f32 $0, $1, $2;", write_only_types=[FP32], read_only_args=[a, b])
+
+
+def _atom_inc_relaxed_gpu(addr, limit):
+    """``atom.relaxed.gpu.global.inc.u32``: the reader ticket; returns the old value, wraps to 0 past ``limit``."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx("atom.relaxed.gpu.global.inc.u32 $0, [$1], $2;", write_only_types=[INT32], read_only_args=[addr, limit])
+
+
+def _smem_addr(arr):
+    """32-bit shared-window address of a shared-memory ``cutlass.Array``."""
+    return INT32(arr.data_ptr().toint())
+
+
+def _mapa_u32(addr32, rank):
+    """``mapa.shared::cluster``: this CTA's shared-window address translated to the same offset in cluster CTA ``rank``'s window."""
+    return nvvm.inline_ptx("mapa.shared::cluster.u32 $0, $1, $2;", write_only_types=[INT32], read_only_args=[addr32, rank])
+
+
+def _st_async_f32(peer_addr32, value, peer_mbar32):
+    """One fp32 into a peer CTA's shared memory, completing 4 tx bytes on the peer's mbarrier (``st.async``; the DSMEM path, not the
+    bulk-copy unit -- the write-back boxes queued there would delay it).  Both addresses are ``mapa``-translated."""
+    nvvm.inline_ptx("st.async.weak.shared::cluster.mbarrier::complete_tx::bytes.f32 [$0], $1, [$2];", read_only_args=[peer_addr32, value, peer_mbar32])
+
+
+def _cta_barrier(threads):
+    """The CTA-wide barrier (id 0, every thread) in its NON-aligned form: the two warpgroup roles reach it from two traced copies of
+    the body (two PCs), which the ``.aligned`` ``bar.sync 0`` promise ("every thread executes the SAME barrier instruction") does not
+    cover -- synccheck flags the aligned form as divergent; the hardware barrier itself counts arrivals per id."""
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync(0, thread_count=threads)
+
+
+def _wg_barrier(barrier_id):
+    """A warpgroup-local named barrier (128 threads): the NON-aligned ``barrier.sync id, 128`` -- it is reached from a warp-role
+    branch, so the ``.aligned`` form (``bar.sync``, which promises that every thread of the CTA executes it) would be undefined
+    (synccheck flags it: "divergent thread(s) in block")."""
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync(barrier_id, thread_count=128)
+
+
+def _select_f32(cond, a, b):
+    """``cond ? a : b`` on fp32 values as one select (no branch)."""
+    return FP32(arith.select(cond.ir_value(), a.ir_value(), b.ir_value()))
+
+
+def _balanced_sum(parts):
+    """The balanced binary tree over ``parts`` in order (``((p0+p1)+(p2+p3))+...``); one part returns itself."""
+    while len(parts) > 1:
+        parts = [parts[i] + parts[i + 1] for i in range(0, len(parts), 2)]
+    return parts[0]
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# straight-line helpers (plain Python: traced inline, no DSL control flow inside)
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _ba_weight_loads(baweight, head, t):
+    """The reference BA partition, weight half: thread ``t`` loads elements ``chunk * 1024 + t * 8 .. + 7`` of ``Wb[h]`` and ``Wa[h]``
+    (parameters: never a predecessor's output, so they load ahead of a PDL wait)."""
+    bw, aw = [], []
+    for c in range(BA_CHUNKS):
+        kk = c * 1024 + t * 8
+        bw.append(ld_global_v4((baweight.iterator + (head * HIDDEN + kk)).toint(), INT32))
+        aw.append(ld_global_v4((baweight.iterator + ((head + V_HEADS) * HIDDEN + kk)).toint(), INT32))
+    return bw, aw
+
+
+def _ba_hidden_loads(hidden, row, t):
+    """The reference BA partition, activation half: elements ``chunk * 1024 + t * 8 .. + 7`` of ``hidden[row]``."""
+    hx = []
+    for c in range(BA_CHUNKS):
+        kk = c * 1024 + t * 8
+        hx.append(ld_global_v4((hidden.iterator + (row * HIDDEN + kk)).toint(), INT32))
+    return hx
+
+
+def _ba_dots(hx, bw, aw, zero):
+    """The reference per-thread fp32 dot chains (40 FFMA each, in its order), accumulating from ``zero`` (+0.0: the constant, or the
+    same +0.0 read from shared memory behind the state-load barrier -- ``fma(h, w, +0.0)`` is bit-identical either way)."""
+    bdot = zero
+    adot = zero
+    for c in range(BA_CHUNKS):
+        for j in range(4):
+            hlo, hhi = _unpack_bf16x2(hx[c][j])
+            blo, bhi = _unpack_bf16x2(bw[c][j])
+            alo, ahi = _unpack_bf16x2(aw[c][j])
+            bdot = bdot + hlo * blo
+            bdot = bdot + hhi * bhi
+            adot = adot + hlo * alo
+            adot = adot + hhi * ahi
+    return bdot, adot
+
+
+def _gmem_ptr(tensor, elem_offset, dtype=BF16):
+    """A 16-byte-aligned GLOBAL pointer to ``tensor[elem_offset]`` for the bulk copies (``cp.async.bulk`` wants an explicit gmem
+    address space; a generic pointer -- what a host trace of CPU tensors carries -- is refused by the primitive)."""
+    return cute.make_ptr(dtype, (tensor.iterator + elem_offset).toint(), cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=16)
+
+
+def _row_gaddr(state, slot, head, rowm, col0, SS):
+    """The global byte address of columns ``col0 ..`` of state row ``rowm`` of head ``head`` in slot ``slot``."""
+    return (state.iterator + (slot * SS + (head * HEAD_DIM + rowm) * HEAD_DIM + col0)).toint()
+
+
+def _load_row_gmem(state, slot, head, rowm, col0, C, SS):
+    """One row slice (``C`` fp32) straight into registers by 16-B vector loads (the ldg128 path)."""
+    base = _row_gaddr(state, slot, head, rowm, col0, SS)
+    vals = []
+    for c4 in range(C // 4):
+        vals.extend(ld_global_v4(base + 16 * c4, FP32))
+    return vals
+
+
+def _store_row_gmem(state, slot, head, rowm, col0, C, SS, vals):
+    base = _row_gaddr(state, slot, head, rowm, col0, SS)
+    for c4 in range(C // 4):
+        st_global_v4(base + 16 * c4, vals[4 * c4 : 4 * c4 + 4], FP32)
+
+
+def _load_row_smem(sbase, m, C):
+    """One row slice from the thread's shared-memory box (``sbase`` = its first row's slice address; rows at the 512-B pitch)."""
+    vals = []
+    for c4 in range(C // 4):
+        vals.extend(ld_shared_v4(sbase + m * ROW_BYTES + 16 * c4, FP32))
+    return vals
+
+
+def _store_row_smem(sbase, m, C, vals):
+    for c4 in range(C // 4):
+        st_shared_v4(sbase + m * ROW_BYTES + 16 * c4, vals[4 * c4 : 4 * c4 + 4], FP32)
+
+
+def _slab_row0(cfg, head, r):
+    """The first state row (within the slot) of the rows CTA ``r`` of head ``head`` owns: ``head x 128 + CTA_ROWS x r``."""
+    return head * HEAD_DIM + cfg.CTA_ROWS * r
+
+
+def _issue_state_boxes(cfg, state, state_s, mb_state, slot, head, r, SS):
+    """Arm the state mbarrier with this CTA's slab bytes and issue the RG box copies (box ``b`` = the CTA's rows ``BOX_ROWS b ..``, one
+    contiguous run in global memory, landing at box pitch ``STATE_BOX_PITCH_ELEMS`` in shared memory)."""
+    nvvm.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(mb_state, cfg.STATE_SLAB_BYTES_CTA)
+    for b in range(cfg.RG):
+        nvvm.cp_async_bulk_shared_cluster_global(
+            state_s.subview(b * cfg.STATE_BOX_PITCH_ELEMS),
+            _gmem_ptr(state, slot * SS + (_slab_row0(cfg, head, r) + b * cfg.BOX_ROWS) * HEAD_DIM, FP32),
+            mb_state,
+            cfg.STATE_BOX_BYTES,
+        )
+
+
+def _issue_state_stores(cfg, state, state_s, slot, head, r, SS):
+    """The RG box stores of the updated rows (``cp.async.bulk.global.shared::cta.bulk_group``) and their commit; the caller waits the
+    group (``wait_group.read 0``) before it exits."""
+    for b in range(cfg.RG):
+        nvvm.cp_async_bulk_global_shared_cta(
+            _gmem_ptr(state, slot * SS + (_slab_row0(cfg, head, r) + b * cfg.BOX_ROWS) * HEAD_DIM, FP32),
+            state_s.subview(b * cfg.STATE_BOX_PITCH_ELEMS),
+            cfg.STATE_BOX_BYTES,
+        )
+    nvvm.cp_async_bulk_commit_group()
+
+
+def _issue_state_half_stores(cfg, state, state_s, slot, head, r, SS, wg):
+    """STORE_PIPELINE: warpgroup ``wg``'s half of every box -- its warps hold rows ``BOX_ROWS b + (BOX_ROWS / 2) wg ..`` of box ``b``, one
+    contiguous run of ``STATE_BOX_BYTES / 2`` in shared memory and in global memory -- as RG bulk stores + one commit, issued by that
+    warpgroup's lane 0 as soon as its own pass 2 is published (the other warpgroup's half follows on its own clock)."""
+    half_rows = cfg.BOX_ROWS // 2
+    for b in range(cfg.RG):
+        nvvm.cp_async_bulk_global_shared_cta(
+            _gmem_ptr(state, slot * SS + (_slab_row0(cfg, head, r) + b * cfg.BOX_ROWS + wg * half_rows) * HEAD_DIM, FP32),
+            state_s.subview(b * cfg.STATE_BOX_PITCH_ELEMS + wg * half_rows * HEAD_DIM),
+            cfg.STATE_BOX_BYTES // 2,
+        )
+    nvvm.cp_async_bulk_commit_group()
+
+
+def _conv_piece_channel0(piece, head, kh):
+    if piece == 0:
+        return kh * HEAD_DIM
+    if piece == 1:
+        return K_CHANNEL0 + kh * HEAD_DIM
+    return V_CHANNEL0 + head * HEAD_DIM
+
+
+def _issue_conv_param_copies(cw, cs, cw_s, hist_s, mb_arr, head, kh, slot, CSS, CSD, CST):
+    """The ``cp.async.bulk`` copies of this head's conv WEIGHTS (3 x 1 KB) and conv HISTORY (per tap 3 x 256 B when the taps are 10240
+    apart, or one 768 B run per piece when the taps are contiguous per channel): written by earlier steps, never by the predecessor
+    grid, so they are issued ahead of a PDL wait."""
+    for piece in range(3):
+        ch0 = _conv_piece_channel0(piece, head, kh)
+        nvvm.cp_async_bulk_shared_cluster_global(
+            cw_s.subview(piece * HEAD_DIM * CONV_WIDTH), _gmem_ptr(cw, ch0 * CONV_WIDTH), mb_arr, HEAD_DIM * CONV_WIDTH * 2
+        )
+        if CSD == 1:
+            for tap in range(CONV_WIDTH - 1):
+                nvvm.cp_async_bulk_shared_cluster_global(
+                    hist_s.subview(piece * (CONV_WIDTH - 1) * HEAD_DIM + tap * HEAD_DIM), _gmem_ptr(cs, slot * CSS + ch0 + tap * CST), mb_arr, HEAD_DIM * 2
+                )
+        else:
+            nvvm.cp_async_bulk_shared_cluster_global(
+                hist_s.subview(piece * (CONV_WIDTH - 1) * HEAD_DIM), _gmem_ptr(cs, slot * CSS + ch0 * (CONV_WIDTH - 1)), mb_arr, (CONV_WIDTH - 1) * HEAD_DIM * 2
+            )
+
+
+def _issue_conv_x_copies(x, x_s, mb_arr, row, head, kh, XS):
+    """The three 256-B copies of this head's Q / K / V pieces of ``x`` (the predecessor's output: after the PDL wait)."""
+    for piece in range(3):
+        ch0 = _conv_piece_channel0(piece, head, kh)
+        nvvm.cp_async_bulk_shared_cluster_global(x_s.subview(piece * HEAD_DIM), _gmem_ptr(x, row * XS + ch0), mb_arr, HEAD_DIM * 2)
+
+
+def _hist(hist_s, piece, tap, c, CSD):
+    """The bf16 conv-history tap ``tap`` of channel ``c`` of piece ``piece`` in shared memory (layout follows the copies above)."""
+    if CSD == 1:
+        return hist_s[piece * (CONV_WIDTH - 1) * HEAD_DIM + tap * HEAD_DIM + c]
+    return hist_s[piece * (CONV_WIDTH - 1) * HEAD_DIM + c * (CONV_WIDTH - 1) + tap]
+
+
+def _conv_channel(piece, u, x_s, cw_s, hist_s, CSD):
+    """The reference ``conv_channel`` (PROUND): four bf16-rounded tap products summed in order, the stock SiLU, bf16.  Returns the
+    fp32 value and the raw bf16 taps 1, 2 and the current input (the shifted history of this channel)."""
+    ch = piece * HEAD_DIM + u
+    taps = [_hist(hist_s, piece, tap, u, CSD) for tap in range(CONV_WIDTH - 1)]
+    cur = x_s[ch]
+    vals = [t.to(FP32) for t in taps] + [cur.to(FP32)]
+    acc = FP32(0)
+    for j in range(CONV_WIDTH):
+        prod = vals[j] * cw_s[ch * CONV_WIDTH + j].to(FP32)
+        prod = prod.to(BF16).to(FP32)
+        acc = acc + prod
+    value = _stock_conv_silu(acc).to(BF16).to(FP32)
+    return value, taps[1], taps[2], cur
+
+
+def _slice_values(base_addr, C):
+    """The ``C`` fp32 values of one q / k slice from shared memory (16-B vector loads)."""
+    vals = []
+    for c4 in range(C // 4):
+        vals.extend(ld_shared_v4(base_addr + 16 * c4, FP32))
+    return vals
+
+
+def _pick_row_value(values, tpr):
+    """``values[tpr]`` for ``tpr < R`` by a select chain (every lane holds every row's value after the butterflies)."""
+    val = values[0]
+    for m in range(1, len(values)):
+        val = _select_f32(tpr == m, values[m], val)
+    return val
+
+
+def _k_group(k, kbase, g, cfg):
+    """The 8 k values of 8-column group ``g``: from the resident slice, or re-read from shared memory (``K_RESIDENT`` off)."""
+    return k[8 * g : 8 * g + 8] if cfg.K_RESIDENT else _slice_values(kbase + 32 * g, 8)
+
+
+def _load_rows_gmem(state, slot, head, rowbase, col0, R, C, SS):
+    """The thread's R row slices straight into registers (the ldg128 path)."""
+    return [_load_row_gmem(state, slot, head, rowbase + m, col0, C, SS) for m in range(R)]
+
+
+def _load_rows_smem(sbase, R, C):
+    """The thread's R row slices from its shared-memory box (the register-resident bulk form)."""
+    return [_load_row_smem(sbase, m, C) for m in range(R)]
+
+
+def _state_passes(cfg, S_rows, state, slot, head, rowbase, col0, sbase, k_s, q_s, v_s, vbase, tpr, decay, beta, SS):
+    """Pass 1 (decay, ``dot = h . k``), the innovation, pass 2 (``h += inn * k``, ``o = h . q``, the row back).  Returns the per-row
+    ``f32(bf16(o))`` values.  Every chain is the reference's: 8 sequential FFMA per 8-column group, the balanced tree over the thread's
+    groups, ``log2(TPR)`` xor shuffles (offsets ``RG << step``: the partners differ in the tpr lane bits).  ``S_rows`` = the R row
+    slices in registers (ldg128, or bulk after the LDS), or None on the streamed bulk form (each pass re-reads the row from ``sbase``
+    and pass 2 recomputes ``h = S * decay``: one FMUL, bit-identical)."""
+    R, C, G, TPR, RG = cfg.R, cfg.C, cfg.GROUPS, cfg.TPR, cfg.RG
+    steps = TPR.bit_length() - 1
+    k_base = _smem_addr(k_s) + tpr * (cfg.SLICE_PITCH * 4)
+    q_base = _smem_addr(q_s) + tpr * (cfg.SLICE_PITCH * 4)
+    k = _slice_values(k_base, C) if cfg.K_RESIDENT else None
+    streamed = S_rows is None
+    # pass 1
+    h = []
+    dots = []
+    for m in range(R):
+        S = _load_row_smem(sbase, m, C) if streamed else S_rows[m]
+        hm = [S[j] * decay for j in range(C)]
+        parts = []
+        for g in range(G):
+            kg = _k_group(k, k_base, g, cfg)
+            p = FP32(0)
+            for j in range(8):
+                p = p + hm[8 * g + j] * kg[j]
+            parts.append(p)
+        s = _balanced_sum(parts)
+        for step in range(steps):
+            s = s + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(s, offset=RG << step)
+        dots.append(s)
+        h.append(None if streamed else hm)
+    inn = [(v_s[vbase + m * cfg.V_PERM_STRIDE] - dots[m]) * beta for m in range(R)]
+    # pass 2
+    values = []
+    for m in range(R):
+        if streamed:
+            # the recomputed decayed row is SINGLE-USE here (pass 1's copy fed the dot), so the compiler could fuse it into the update
+            # as fma(S, decay, inn * k) -- the reference rounds the product first (its FMUL), then fma(inn, k, h): spell it unfusable
+            S = _load_row_smem(sbase, m, C)
+            hm = [_mul_rn_f32(S[j], decay) for j in range(C)]
+        else:
+            hm = h[m]
+        parts = []
+        for g in range(G):
+            kg = _k_group(k, k_base, g, cfg)
+            qg = _slice_values(q_base + 32 * g, 8)
+            o = FP32(0)
+            for j in range(8):
+                idx = 8 * g + j
+                hm[idx] = hm[idx] + inn[m] * kg[j]
+                o = o + hm[idx] * qg[j]
+            parts.append(o)
+        s = _balanced_sum(parts)
+        for step in range(steps):
+            s = s + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(s, offset=RG << step)
+        values.append(s.to(BF16).to(FP32))
+        if cfg.BULK_STATE:
+            _store_row_smem(sbase, m, C, hm)
+        else:
+            _store_row_gmem(state, slot, head, rowbase + m, col0, C, SS, hm)
+    return values
+
+
+def _row_square_sum(values):
+    """The in-thread leaf of the norm tree: the balanced sum of the rows' squares (explicit ``mul.rn.f32``, never fused)."""
+    return _balanced_sum([_mul_rn_f32(v, v) for v in values])
+
+
+def _norm_total(norm_part, RG, WARPS):
+    """The reference 128-leaf balanced tree from the aligned-block partials: over the WARPS warps of each box in order, then over the
+    boxes in order."""
+    return _balanced_sum([_balanced_sum([norm_part[g * WARPS + wi] for wi in range(WARPS)]) for g in range(RG)])
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# the thread geometry (plain Python: the same integers in the role bodies and in the tail)
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _lane_geometry(cfg, tid, r, state_s):
+    """``warp, lane, tpr, rg, rowbase, col0, orow, vbase, u, wl, sbase`` of thread ``tid`` of CTA ``r`` of the head's pair (0 on the
+    one-CTA form) -- the mapping of the module docstring."""
+    R, C, RG = cfg.R, cfg.C, cfg.RG
+    warp = tid // 32
+    lane = tid % 32
+    tpr = lane // RG  # the column slice
+    rg = lane % RG  # the row group = the state box
+    rowbase = cfg.CTA_ROWS * r + cfg.BOX_ROWS * rg + R * warp  # the thread's rows: rowbase + m, m < R (R consecutive, R-aligned rows of box rg)
+    col0 = tpr * C
+    mo = cutlass.min(tpr, R - 1)  # the row this thread outputs (the tpr < R threads each take one of the row group's R rows)
+    orow = rowbase + mo
+    vbase = (R * warp) * cfg.V_PERM_STRIDE + r * RG + rg  # v_s index of row rowbase (+ m * V_PERM_STRIDE): the RG lanes of a phase read consecutive words
+    u = tid % 128  # the BA partition index and the conv-role channel index
+    wl = (tid % 128) // 32  # warp within the warpgroup
+    sbase = INT32(0)
+    if cfg.BULK_STATE:
+        sbase = _smem_addr(state_s) + rg * (cfg.STATE_BOX_PITCH_ELEMS * 4) + (R * warp) * ROW_BYTES + col0 * 4
+    return warp, lane, tpr, rg, rowbase, col0, orow, vbase, u, wl, sbase
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# the role-independent tail: the hand-over, (bulk) the slab wait + LDS, the passes, the norm, the outputs, the shift, the drain
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+@cute.jit
+def _tail_live(
+    cfg: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    tid,
+    head,
+    row,
+    kh,
+    r,
+    slot,
+    scv,
+    wv,
+    zv_in,
+    S_rows_in,
+    cs,
+    state,
+    z,
+    out,
+    qout,
+    raw,
+    x_s,
+    hist_s,
+    q_s,
+    k_s,
+    v_s,
+    scal_s,
+    ticket_s,
+    norm_part,
+    norm_peer_s,
+    mb_state,
+    mb_norm,
+    state_s,
+    ZS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CSS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CSD: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CST: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    SS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    EPS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    """A live slot after the role work.  ``S_rows_in`` = the row slices the role body loaded into registers (ldg128) or an empty
+    list (bulk: they are read from the shared-memory boxes here).  Traced once per role copy on the twice-traced body, ONCE per kernel
+    under ``SINGLE_TAIL``; the slab stores and their drain belong to thread 0."""
+    TPR = cfg.TPR
+    R = cfg.R
+    C = cfg.C
+    RG = cfg.RG
+    WARPS = cfg.WARPS
+    BULK = cfg.BULK_STATE
+    SHIFT_CHANNELS = 2 * HEAD_DIM // cfg.SHIFT_LANES
+    warp, lane, tpr, rg, rowbase, col0, orow, vbase, u, wl, sbase = _lane_geometry(cfg, tid, r, state_s)
+    zv = zv_in
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.PDL):
+        # the predecessor's output: read after this thread's griddepcontrol.wait (in its role body); issued here, consumed at the epilogue
+        zv = z[row * ZS + head * HEAD_DIM + orow].to(FP32)
+    _cta_barrier(cfg.THREADS)
+    S_rows = S_rows_in
+    if cutlass.const_expr(BULK):
+        wait(mb_state, 0)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(not cfg.STATE_STREAM):
+            S_rows = _load_rows_smem(sbase, R, C)
+        else:
+            S_rows = None
+    values = _state_passes(cfg, S_rows, state, slot, head, rowbase, col0, sbase, k_s, q_s, v_s, vbase, tpr, scal_s[0], scal_s[1], SS)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(BULK):
+        cute.arch.fence_view_async_shared()  # this thread's STS of the updated rows -> visible to the bulk store (async proxy)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.STORE_PIPELINE):
+            # this warpgroup's half of every box is final: its warps 1-3 ARRIVE on the warpgroup's named barrier (96 threads, no wait), its
+            # warp 0 SYNCS on it (32 threads: warp-uniform participation, no intra-warp divergence at a barrier) and that warp's lane 0
+            # issues the RG half-box stores -- the write-back of each half starts at its own pass-2 end instead of at the CTA barrier
+            # below.  Ids: 2 on warpgroup 0, 1 on warpgroup 1 (both free again: their earlier uses are complete).  SUM = 96 + 32 = 128
+            wg = tid // 128
+            store_bar = 2 - wg
+            if wl == 0:
+                nvvm.barrier_cta_sync(store_bar, thread_count=128)
+                if lane == 0:
+                    _issue_state_half_stores(cfg, state, state_s, slot, head, r, SS, wg)
+            else:
+                nvvm.barrier_cta_arrive(store_bar, 128)
+    pre = _row_square_sum(values)  # the aligned block of this thread's R consecutive rows
+    if tpr == 0:
+        norm_part[rg * WARPS + warp] = pre
+    _cta_barrier(cfg.THREADS)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(BULK and not cfg.STORE_PIPELINE):
+        if tid == 0:
+            _issue_state_stores(cfg, state, state_s, slot, head, r, SS)
+    ss = _norm_total(norm_part, RG, WARPS)  # the balanced tree over this CTA's rows (T128, or T64 of its half)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD):
+        # the peer's T64: thread 0 ships this CTA's T64 into the peer's slot (one st.async completing 4 tx bytes on the peer's mb_norm)
+        # after the P4 cluster wait (the peer's mbarrier init is visible), arming its OWN mb_norm first; every thread waits the peer's
+        # bytes.  T128 = T64(rows 0-63) + T64(rows 64-127): fp32 addition is commutative, so both ranks compute the same bits.
+        nvvm.barrier_cluster_wait()
+        if tid == 0:
+            nvvm.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(mb_norm, NORM_XFER_BYTES)
+            peer = INT32(cfg.CTAS_PER_HEAD - 1) - r
+            _st_async_f32(_mapa_u32(_smem_addr(norm_peer_s), peer), ss, _mapa_u32(_smem_addr(mb_norm), peer))
+        wait(mb_norm, 0)
+        ss = ss + norm_peer_s[0]
+    inv = cute.math.rsqrt(ss / FP32(HEAD_DIM) + FP32(EPS))
+    if tpr < R:
+        val = _pick_row_value(values, tpr)
+        oi = row * (V_HEADS * HEAD_DIM) + head * HEAD_DIM + orow
+        rounded = (((val * inv) * wv) * (zv / (FP32(1) + cute.math.exp(-zv)))).to(BF16)
+        qout[oi] = _quant_fp8_word(rounded.to(FP32), scv).to(UINT8)
+        out[oi] = rounded
+        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.DEBUG):
+            raw[oi] = val.to(BF16)
+    # ---- the last of the three readers shifts the K head's Q / K conv history (its taps are in smem) ----
+    if ticket_s[0] == cfg.TICKET_LIMIT:
+        if tpr == TPR - 1:
+            sidx2 = warp * RG + rg
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(SHIFT_CHANNELS):
+                ix = sidx2 + i * cfg.SHIFT_LANES
+                piece = ix // HEAD_DIM
+                c = ix % HEAD_DIM
+                channel = kh * HEAD_DIM + c + piece * K_CHANNEL0
+                off = slot * CSS + channel * CSD
+                cs[off] = _hist(hist_s, piece, 1, c, CSD)
+                cs[off + CST] = _hist(hist_s, piece, 2, c, CSD)
+                cs[off + 2 * CST] = x_s[piece * HEAD_DIM + c]
+    if cutlass.const_expr(BULK):
+        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.STORE_PIPELINE):
+            if tid % 128 == 0:
+                nvvm.cp_async_bulk_wait_group(0, read=True)  # each issuing lane: its half-boxes are read out of smem before the CTA retires
+        else:
+            if tid == 0:
+                nvvm.cp_async_bulk_wait_group(0, read=True)  # the boxes are read out of smem before this CTA retires
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tail_null(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, tid, head, row, r, out, qout, raw, state_s):
+    """The null slot: zero outputs, nothing else touched (the PDL wait, when any, was taken in the role body; on the two-CTA form the
+    cluster wait pairs with the entry arrive -- nothing is shipped)."""
+    warp, lane, tpr, rg, rowbase, col0, orow, vbase, u, wl, sbase = _lane_geometry(cfg, tid, r, state_s)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.TWO_CTAS_PER_HEAD):
+        nvvm.barrier_cluster_wait()
+    if tpr < cfg.R:
+        oi = row * (V_HEADS * HEAD_DIM) + head * HEAD_DIM + orow
+        qout[oi] = UINT8(0)
+        out[oi] = BF16(0)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.DEBUG):
+            raw[oi] = BF16(0)
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# the warpgroup role body (ROLE 0 = BA, 1 = conv, 2 = both, 3 = neither); WITH_TAIL traces the tail inside it (the twice-traced body)
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+@cute.jit
+def _role_body(
+    cfg: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ROLE: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    WITH_TAIL: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    tid,
+    head,
+    row,
+    kh,
+    r,
+    slot,
+    scv,
+    dtv,
+    alv,
+    wv,
+    zv,
+    x,
+    cs,
+    cw,
+    state,
+    z,
+    counts,
+    out,
+    qout,
+    hidden,
+    baweight,
+    raw,
+    convout,
+    baout,
+    x_s,
+    cw_s,
+    hist_s,
+    qk_raw,
+    q_s,
+    k_s,
+    v_s,
+    scal_s,
+    ticket_s,
+    ba_part,
+    norm_part,
+    norm_peer_s,
+    mb_arr,
+    mb_state,
+    mb_norm,
+    state_s,
+    XS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ZS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CSS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CSD: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CST: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    SS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    EPS: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    R = cfg.R
+    C = cfg.C
+    RG = cfg.RG

## CodeQL / Explicit returns mixed with implicit (fall through) returns

Mixing implicit and explicit returns may indicate an error, as implicit returns always return None.

[Show more details](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/security/code-scanning/4773)

+def test_row_envelope(as_sm100):

+def test_verify_step_shape_envelope(as_sm100):

+    pair at one request holds 35, the one-CTA form at requests 2 .. 3 holds 8, the two-CTAs-per-SM form from 4 requests on holds 45), one
+    grid row per request up to 65535."""
+    pair, one_cta, two_cta = _sm100_verify_form("cuda:0", 1), _sm100_verify_form("cuda:0", 3), _sm100_verify_form("cuda:0", 4)

+    sup = _probe("cuda:0", "verify", requests=2, tokens_per_request=1)
+    assert (sup.served, sup.kind) == (False, "shape") and "decode form" in sup.reason, sup
+    assert backend.VERIFY_MAX_REQUESTS == ventry.MAX_REQUESTS == 65535, "one source: the entry's own bound"
+    sup = _probe("cuda:0", "verify", requests=backend.VERIFY_MAX_REQUESTS + 1, tokens_per_request=4)
+    assert (sup.served, sup.kind) == (False, "shape") and str(backend.VERIFY_MAX_REQUESTS) in sup.reason, sup

+def test_verify_token_bound_reads_the_device_and_reports_a_failed_reading_as_a_device_decline(monkeypatch):

+    seen = []

+    def form(device, requests=None, norm_eps=1e-6):

+    assert _probe("cuda:0", "verify", requests=2).served and len(seen) == 1, "no tokens count: no device reading needed"

+    def failing(device, requests=None, norm_eps=1e-6):

+def test_build_declines_parameter_dtypes_before_any_device_work():
+    for dtypes in ((F32, F32, F32), (BF16, BF16, BF16), (F32, F32, BF16), (F32, BF16, F32), (BF16, BF16, BF16)):
+        with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="dt_bias torch.bfloat16 and norm_weight torch.bfloat16"):
+            backend.build(_spec(param_dtypes=dtypes))  # a CPU spec: the dtypes are the decline, not the device
+        with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="CUDA devices"):
+            backend.build(_spec(form="verify", tokens=4, param_dtypes=dtypes))  # the verify kernel reads every dtype choice: the device is the decline
+    assert backend._param_dtypes_error((F32, BF16, BF16)) is None

+def test_runner_maps_flashinfer_inputs_onto_the_entry_call_contract():

+    runner = backend.FrostFeDecodeRunner(spec)  # a host entry (no SM count to pick by); the output slots are allocated on the CPU

+    kw = runner._kwargs(x)

+def test_runner_launch_re_checks_the_binding():
+    """FlashInfer's ``bind_inputs`` checks dtypes and shapes; the entries re-check the whole binding (alignment and layout too) on every
+    launch, before the compiled kernel sees the pointers: with a kernel planted under the binding's compile key, a misaligned operand is a
+    typed decline at ``run``, never a launch -- on both runners."""
+
+    def launched(*args):
+        raise AssertionError("the planted kernel was launched on a mismatched binding")
+
+    spec = _spec(rows=2)
+    x = fi_api.bind_inputs(spec, **_tensors(2, CPU))
+    runner = backend.FrostFeDecodeRunner(spec)
+    args = runner._args(x)
+    runner.kernel.compiled[runner.kernel.key(args[0], args[1], args[2], args[6], args[8])] = launched
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="norm weight|aligned"):
+        runner.run(replace(x, norm_weight=torch.ones(136, dtype=BF16)[1:129]))  # the right dtype and shape at a 2-byte offset
+    vspec = _spec(form="verify", rows=2, tokens=4)
+    vx = fi_api.bind_inputs(vspec, **_verify_tensors(2, 4, CPU))
+    vrunner = backend.FrostFeVerifyRunner(vspec)
+    kw = vrunner._kwargs(vx)
+    vrunner.kernel.compiled[
+        vrunner.kernel.key(kw["qkv"], kw["z"], kw["A_log"], kw["dt_bias"], kw["ssm_state"], kw["state_indices"], kw["norm_weight"], kw["conv_state"])
+    ] = launched
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="norm_weight"):
+        vrunner.run(replace(vx, norm_weight=torch.ones(136, dtype=BF16)[1:129]))
+
+
+def test_support_probe_loads_no_kernel_module():
+    code = textwrap.dedent("""
+        import sys
+        import cudnn.linear_attention.frost.flashinfer_gdn_backend as b
+        from flashinfer.qwen_3_5_gdn_block import Qwen35GdnGeometry, qwen_3_5_gdn_block_support

+            sup = qwen_3_5_gdn_block_support("cpu", Qwen35GdnGeometry(**b.GEOMETRY), form, b.BACKEND, **kw)
+            assert not sup.served and sup.kind == "device", sup
+        kernels = ("gdn_decode_fused_f16", "gdn_verify_fused_f16", "flashinfer.experimental.qwen_3_5_gdn_block.backends.frost.gdn", "flashinfer.experimental.qwen_3_5_gdn_block.backends.frost.gdn_verify")
+        loaded = [m for m in sys.modules if m.endswith(kernels)]
+        assert not loaded, loaded
+        print("PROBE-OK")
+        """)
+    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
+    assert r.returncode == 0 and "PROBE-OK" in r.stdout, r.stderr[-3000:]
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# device
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _device_or_skip(form="decode", **kw):
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        pytest.skip("needs a CUDA device")

+    if not sup.served:
+        pytest.skip(f"frost_fe is not served here ({form}): {sup.kind}: {sup.reason}")
+    return dev
+
+
+def _flashinfer_root():
+    import flashinfer
+
+    root = Path(flashinfer.__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+    if not (root / "tests" / "experimental" / "qwen_3_5_gdn_block" / "test_frost_decode.py").is_file():

+    typed decline at ``run``, never a launch -- on both runners."""

+    cell produced: a wider QKVZ slab (another qkv / z row stride).  Under capture that binding is refused; after one eager run the same
+    binding captures, and the replay is bitwise the eager run."""

+    slab = torch.zeros(rows, 16384 + 1024, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)  # row stride 17408 (a 16-byte multiple): a new compile key

+    slab[:, 10240:16384] = case.z.reshape(rows, 6144)
+    case.qkv, case.z = slab[:, :10240], slab[:, 10240:16384].view(rows, 48, 128)

+    q_a, out_a = fi.dec._outputs(rows, dev)
+    plan.run(**fi.dec._tensors(case, ssm_a, conv_a), out=q_a, out_bf16=out_a)  # the eager run compiles the binding
+    ssm_b, conv_b = case.ssm_state.clone(), case.conv_state.clone()
+    q_b, out_b = fi.dec._outputs(rows, dev)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        plan.run(**fi.dec._tensors(case, ssm_b, conv_b), out=q_b, out_bf16=out_b)
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    assert torch.equal(q_a.view(torch.uint8), q_b.view(torch.uint8)) and torch.equal(out_a, out_b)
+    assert torch.equal(ssm_a, ssm_b) and torch.equal(conv_a, conv_b)
+    fi.dec._check(case, q_b, out_b, ssm_b, conv_b)

+
+def test_bitwise_with_the_built_in_frost_backend():
+    dev = _device_or_skip()
+    fi = _flashinfer_tests()
+    sup = qwen_3_5_gdn_block_support(dev, GEOMETRY, "decode", "frost")
+    if not sup.served:
+        pytest.skip(f"FlashInfer's built-in frost backend is not served here: {sup.reason}")
+    for rows in (1, 2, 4, 8):
+        case = fi.ref.make_case(rows, 1, seed=100 + rows, device=dev, form="decode")
+        got = {}
+        for name in ("frost", backend.BACKEND):
+            ssm, conv = case.ssm_state.clone(), case.conv_state.clone()
+            q, out = fi.dec._outputs(rows, dev)
+            qwen_3_5_gdn_block_decode(**fi.dec._tensors(case, ssm, conv), geometry=GEOMETRY, backend=name, out=q, out_bf16=out)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            got[name] = (q.view(torch.uint8), out, ssm, conv)
+        for a, b, what in zip(got["frost"], got[backend.BACKEND], ("fp8 out", "bf16 out", "ssm state", "conv state")):
+            assert torch.equal(a, b), f"rows {rows}: {what} differs between frost and frost_fe"
+
+
+# --- verify ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _verify_device_or_skip(requests, tokens):
+    return _device_or_skip("verify", requests=requests, tokens_per_request=tokens)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("requests, tokens", VERIFY_SHAPES, ids=lambda v: str(v))

+    for dtypes in ((F32, F32, F32), (BF16, BF16, BF16), (F32, F32, BF16), (F32, BF16, F32), (BF16, BF16, BF16)):
+        with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="dt_bias torch.bfloat16 and norm_weight torch.bfloat16"):
+            backend.build(_spec(param_dtypes=dtypes))  # a CPU spec: the dtypes are the decline, not the device
+        with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="CUDA devices"):
+            backend.build(_spec(form="verify", tokens=4, param_dtypes=dtypes))  # the verify kernel reads every dtype choice: the device is the decline
+    assert backend._param_dtypes_error((F32, BF16, BF16)) is None
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="decode kernel runs on CUDA devices"):
+        backend.build(_spec())  # the kernel-native dtypes on a CPU device
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="verify kernel runs on CUDA devices"):
+        backend.build(_spec(form="verify", tokens=4))
+
+
+def test_runner_maps_flashinfer_inputs_onto_the_entry_call_contract():
+    spec = _spec(rows=2)
+    t = _tensors(2, CPU)
+    x = fi_api.bind_inputs(spec, **t)  # FlashInfer's own operand checks admit the set
+    runner = backend.FrostFeDecodeRunner(spec)  # a host entry (no SM count to pick by); the output slots are allocated on the CPU
+    args = runner._args(x)
+    assert args[0] == 2
+    assert [
+        a is b
+        for a, b in zip(
+            args[1:],
+            (x.qkv, x.conv_state, x.conv_weight, x.A_log, x.dt_bias, x.ssm_state, x.state_indices, x.z, x.norm_weight, x.out_scale, x.hidden, x.ba_weight),
+        )
+    ] == [True] * 12
+    entry.check_support(*args, device_cc=(10, 0))  # the entry's host checks accept FlashInfer's serving layout (channel-innermost conv pool)
+    dim_first = fi_api.bind_inputs(spec, **dict(t, conv_state=t["conv_state"].contiguous()))  # [slots, C, 3]: tap-contiguous channels
+    assert tuple(dim_first.conv_state.stride()) == (30720, 3, 1)
+    entry.check_support(*runner._args(dim_first), device_cc=(10, 0))
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="eagerly"):
+        runner.run(x)  # nothing compiled for this binding: refused before any launch (the CUDA-graph guard, visible on the host)
+    assert runner.buffers is runner.kernel.outputs(2) and runner.scratch_bf16 is runner.buffers["out"]
+    assert runner.kernel.compiled is backend._shared_compiled(_spec(rows=4)), "plans of one form, device and epsilon share the compiled table"
+    other = fi_api.Qwen35GdnPlanSpec(backend.BACKEND, "decode", 2, 1, Qwen35GdnGeometry(**backend.GEOMETRY, norm_eps=1e-5), CPU, (F32, BF16, BF16))
+    assert backend._shared_compiled(other) is not runner.kernel.compiled
+    assert backend._shared_compiled(_spec(form="verify", rows=2, tokens=4)) is not runner.kernel.compiled, "the two forms never share a table"
+

+def test_verify_runner_maps_flashinfer_inputs_onto_the_entry_call_contract():
+    spec = _spec(form="verify", rows=2, tokens=4)
+    t = _verify_tensors(2, 4, CPU)
+    x = fi_api.bind_inputs(spec, **t)  # FlashInfer's own operand checks admit the set
+    runner = backend.FrostFeVerifyRunner(spec)  # a host entry (no device readings: the one-CTA form); the buffers are allocated on the CPU
+    kw = runner._kwargs(x)
+    assert list(kw) == list(ventry.OPERANDS) + ["out", "out_bf16"]
+    assert [kw[name] is getattr(x, name) for name in ventry.OPERANDS] == [True] * 14 and kw["out"] is x.out and kw["out_bf16"] is None
+    ventry.check_support(**kw, device_cc=(10, 0))  # the entry's host checks accept FlashInfer's verify layout (channel-contiguous conv pool)
+    assert ventry.step_shape(kw["state_indices"]) == (spec.requests, spec.tokens_per_request) == (2, 4)
+    dim_first = fi_api.bind_inputs(spec, **dict(t, conv_state=t["conv_state"].contiguous()))  # [slots, C, T + 2]: FlashInfer admits it ...
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="channel-contiguous"):  # ... the verify kernel does not fuse it: the typed decline prepare raises
+        ventry.check_support(**runner._kwargs(dim_first), device_cc=(10, 0))
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="eagerly"):
+        runner.run(x)  # nothing compiled for this binding: refused before any launch (the CUDA-graph guard, visible on the host)
+    assert runner.buffers is runner.kernel.outputs(2, 4) and runner.buffers["counts"].shape == (2 * kvcfg.TICKET_STRIDE,)
+    assert runner.kernel.compiled is backend._shared_compiled(_spec(form="verify", rows=4, tokens=6)), "verify plans of one device and epsilon share"
+    assert runner.kernel.compiled is not backend._shared_compiled(_spec(rows=2))
+    bf16 = fi_api.bind_inputs(spec, **dict(t, out_bf16=torch.empty(8, 48, 128, dtype=BF16)))
+    assert runner._kwargs(bf16)["out_bf16"] is bf16.out_bf16

+def test_runner_launch_re_checks_the_binding():
+    """FlashInfer's ``bind_inputs`` checks dtypes and shapes; the entries re-check the whole binding (alignment and layout too) on every
+    launch, before the compiled kernel sees the pointers: with a kernel planted under the binding's compile key, a misaligned operand is a
+    typed decline at ``run``, never a launch -- on both runners."""
+
+    def launched(*args):
+        raise AssertionError("the planted kernel was launched on a mismatched binding")
+
+    spec = _spec(rows=2)
+    x = fi_api.bind_inputs(spec, **_tensors(2, CPU))
+    runner = backend.FrostFeDecodeRunner(spec)
+    args = runner._args(x)
+    runner.kernel.compiled[runner.kernel.key(args[0], args[1], args[2], args[6], args[8])] = launched
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="norm weight|aligned"):
+        runner.run(replace(x, norm_weight=torch.ones(136, dtype=BF16)[1:129]))  # the right dtype and shape at a 2-byte offset
+    vspec = _spec(form="verify", rows=2, tokens=4)
+    vx = fi_api.bind_inputs(vspec, **_verify_tensors(2, 4, CPU))
+    vrunner = backend.FrostFeVerifyRunner(vspec)
+    kw = vrunner._kwargs(vx)
+    vrunner.kernel.compiled[
+        vrunner.kernel.key(kw["qkv"], kw["z"], kw["A_log"], kw["dt_bias"], kw["ssm_state"], kw["state_indices"], kw["norm_weight"], kw["conv_state"])
+    ] = launched
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="norm_weight"):
+        vrunner.run(replace(vx, norm_weight=torch.ones(136, dtype=BF16)[1:129]))
+
+
+def test_support_probe_loads_no_kernel_module():
+    code = textwrap.dedent("""
+        import sys
+        import cudnn.linear_attention.frost.flashinfer_gdn_backend as b
+        from flashinfer.qwen_3_5_gdn_block import Qwen35GdnGeometry, qwen_3_5_gdn_block_support
+        for form, kw in (("decode", {}), ("verify", dict(requests=2, tokens_per_request=6))):
+            sup = qwen_3_5_gdn_block_support("cpu", Qwen35GdnGeometry(**b.GEOMETRY), form, b.BACKEND, **kw)
+            assert not sup.served and sup.kind == "device", sup
+        kernels = ("gdn_decode_fused_f16", "gdn_verify_fused_f16", "flashinfer.experimental.qwen_3_5_gdn_block.backends.frost.gdn", "flashinfer.experimental.qwen_3_5_gdn_block.backends.frost.gdn_verify")
+        loaded = [m for m in sys.modules if m.endswith(kernels)]
+        assert not loaded, loaded
+        print("PROBE-OK")
+        """)
+    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
+    assert r.returncode == 0 and "PROBE-OK" in r.stdout, r.stderr[-3000:]
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# device
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _device_or_skip(form="decode", **kw):
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        pytest.skip("needs a CUDA device")
+    dev = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+    sup = _probe(dev, form, **kw)
+    if not sup.served:
+        pytest.skip(f"frost_fe is not served here ({form}): {sup.kind}: {sup.reason}")
+    return dev
+
+
+def _flashinfer_root():
+    import flashinfer
+
+    root = Path(flashinfer.__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+    if not (root / "tests" / "experimental" / "qwen_3_5_gdn_block" / "test_frost_decode.py").is_file():
+        pytest.skip("FlashInfer's tests/experimental/qwen_3_5_gdn_block is not next to the installed package (a source tree is needed)")
+    if str(root) not in sys.path:
+        sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
+    return root
+
+
+def _flashinfer_tests():
+    """FlashInfer's own GDN block tests and torch reference (``ref``, ``dec``, ``ver``): importable from a source tree next to the
+    installed package only.  The cells below call these modules' internals (their test functions, ``reference``, a plan's ``_runner``)
+    as FlashInfer PR #8131 laid them out -- a FlashInfer that reshapes its test package skips here rather than failing, and the cells
+    that read ``plan._runner`` are pinned to that layout."""
+    _flashinfer_root()
+    try:
+        return types.SimpleNamespace(
+            ref=importlib.import_module("tests.experimental.qwen_3_5_gdn_block.reference"),
+            dec=importlib.import_module("tests.experimental.qwen_3_5_gdn_block.test_frost_decode"),
+            ver=importlib.import_module("tests.experimental.qwen_3_5_gdn_block.test_frost_verify"),
+        )
+    except ImportError as exc:
+        pytest.skip(f"FlashInfer's test package did not import: {exc}")
+
+
+def _flashinfer_bench():
+    """FlashInfer's ``benchmarks/bench_qwen_3_5_gdn_block.py`` (its input sets in the serving layout), from the source tree."""
+    path = _flashinfer_root() / "benchmarks" / "bench_qwen_3_5_gdn_block.py"
+    if not path.is_file():
+        pytest.skip("FlashInfer's benchmarks/bench_qwen_3_5_gdn_block.py is not next to the installed package")
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("flashinfer_bench_qwen_3_5_gdn_block", path)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    try:
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    except ImportError as exc:
+        pytest.skip(f"FlashInfer's benchmark did not import: {exc}")
+    return module
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", ROWS)
+def test_flashinfer_decode_reference_test_passes_against_frost_fe(monkeypatch, rows):
+    """FlashInfer's ``test_decode_matches_reference`` with its entry point bound to ``backend="frost_fe"``: its tolerances, the cuDNN Frontend kernel."""
+    dev = _device_or_skip()
+    fi = _flashinfer_tests()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fi.dec, "qwen_3_5_gdn_block_decode", functools.partial(qwen_3_5_gdn_block_decode, backend=backend.BACKEND))
+    fi.dec.test_decode_matches_reference(dev, rows)
+
+
+def test_flashinfer_cuda_graph_replay_test_passes_against_frost_fe(monkeypatch):
+    dev = _device_or_skip()
+    fi = _flashinfer_tests()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fi.dec, "prepare_qwen_3_5_gdn_block", functools.partial(prepare_qwen_3_5_gdn_block, backend=backend.BACKEND))
+    fi.dec.test_decode_cuda_graph_replay_matches_eager(dev)
+
+
+def test_dim_first_conv_pool_is_served_and_fp32_parameters_are_declined():
+    dev = _device_or_skip()
+    fi = _flashinfer_tests()
+    case = fi.ref.make_case(4, 1, seed=7, device=dev, form="decode", conv_dim_first=True)  # [slots, C, 3], the kernel-native dtypes
+    ssm, conv = case.ssm_state.clone(), case.conv_state.clone()
+    _, out = fi.dec._outputs(4, dev)
+    q = qwen_3_5_gdn_block_decode(**fi.dec._tensors(case, ssm, conv), geometry=fi.dec.GEOMETRY, backend=backend.BACKEND, out_bf16=out)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    fi.dec._check(case, q, out, ssm, conv)
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="norm_weight"):  # FlashInfer's fp32-parameter cell: declined at plan time, by name
+        prepare_qwen_3_5_gdn_block("decode", geometry=GEOMETRY, device=dev, requests=4, backend=backend.BACKEND, param_dtypes=(F32, F32, F32))
+
+
+def test_capture_of_an_unprepared_binding_is_refused_until_an_eager_run_compiled_it():
+    """The compiled table is shared by every plan of one device and epsilon, so the cold binding must carry a compile-key fact no earlier
+    cell produced: a wider QKVZ slab (another qkv / z row stride).  Under capture that binding is refused; after one eager run the same
+    binding captures, and the replay is bitwise the eager run."""
+    dev = _device_or_skip()
+    fi = _flashinfer_tests()
+    rows = 2
+    plan = prepare_qwen_3_5_gdn_block("decode", geometry=GEOMETRY, device=dev, requests=rows, backend=backend.BACKEND)
+    case = fi.ref.make_case(rows, 1, seed=3, device=dev, form="decode")
+    slab = torch.zeros(rows, 16384 + 1024, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)  # row stride 17408 (a 16-byte multiple): a new compile key
+    slab[:, :10240] = case.qkv
+    slab[:, 10240:16384] = case.z.reshape(rows, 6144)
+    case.qkv, case.z = slab[:, :10240], slab[:, 10240:16384].view(rows, 48, 128)
+    q, out = fi.dec._outputs(rows, dev)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="eagerly"):
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            plan.run(**fi.dec._tensors(case, case.ssm_state.clone(), case.conv_state.clone()), out=q, out_bf16=out)
+    ssm_a, conv_a = case.ssm_state.clone(), case.conv_state.clone()
+    q_a, out_a = fi.dec._outputs(rows, dev)
+    plan.run(**fi.dec._tensors(case, ssm_a, conv_a), out=q_a, out_bf16=out_a)  # the eager run compiles the binding
+    ssm_b, conv_b = case.ssm_state.clone(), case.conv_state.clone()
+    q_b, out_b = fi.dec._outputs(rows, dev)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        plan.run(**fi.dec._tensors(case, ssm_b, conv_b), out=q_b, out_bf16=out_b)
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    assert torch.equal(q_a.view(torch.uint8), q_b.view(torch.uint8)) and torch.equal(out_a, out_b)
+    assert torch.equal(ssm_a, ssm_b) and torch.equal(conv_a, conv_b)
+    fi.dec._check(case, q_b, out_b, ssm_b, conv_b)
+
+
+def test_bitwise_with_the_built_in_frost_backend():
+    dev = _device_or_skip()
+    fi = _flashinfer_tests()
+    sup = qwen_3_5_gdn_block_support(dev, GEOMETRY, "decode", "frost")
+    if not sup.served:
+        pytest.skip(f"FlashInfer's built-in frost backend is not served here: {sup.reason}")
+    for rows in (1, 2, 4, 8):
+        case = fi.ref.make_case(rows, 1, seed=100 + rows, device=dev, form="decode")
+        got = {}
+        for name in ("frost", backend.BACKEND):
+            ssm, conv = case.ssm_state.clone(), case.conv_state.clone()
+            q, out = fi.dec._outputs(rows, dev)
+            qwen_3_5_gdn_block_decode(**fi.dec._tensors(case, ssm, conv), geometry=GEOMETRY, backend=name, out=q, out_bf16=out)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            got[name] = (q.view(torch.uint8), out, ssm, conv)
+        for a, b, what in zip(got["frost"], got[backend.BACKEND], ("fp8 out", "bf16 out", "ssm state", "conv state")):
+            assert torch.equal(a, b), f"rows {rows}: {what} differs between frost and frost_fe"
+
+
+# --- verify ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _verify_device_or_skip(requests, tokens):
+    return _device_or_skip("verify", requests=requests, tokens_per_request=tokens)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("requests, tokens", VERIFY_SHAPES, ids=lambda v: str(v))
+def test_flashinfer_verify_reference_test_passes_against_frost_fe(monkeypatch, requests, tokens):
+    """FlashInfer's ``test_verify_matches_reference`` under its device launch policy with its entry point bound to ``backend="frost_fe"``:
+    its tolerances (the bf16 output within 2^-6 relative + 1e-3, > 99.9 % of the live fp8 bytes, the conv pool bitwise, written state
+    slots within 1e-4, untouched slots untouched, padding outputs zero), the cuDNN Frontend kernel."""
+    dev = _verify_device_or_skip(requests, tokens)
+    fi = _flashinfer_tests()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fi.ver, "qwen_3_5_gdn_block_verify", functools.partial(qwen_3_5_gdn_block_verify, backend=backend.BACKEND))
+    fi.ver.test_verify_matches_reference(dev, requests, tokens, "device")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("policy", sorted(POLICY_SMS))
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("requests, tokens", VERIFY_SHAPES, ids=lambda v: str(v))

+            if int(idx[n, 0]) <= 0:
+                continue
+            want = {"first": 1, "mid": tokens // 2, "last": tokens - 1}[skip]
+            if want == int(acc[n]) - 1:  # never the source slot
+                want = want + 1 if want + 1 < tokens else want - 1
+            if 1 <= want < tokens and want != int(acc[n]) - 1:
+                idx[n, want] = 0
+    ops = dict(
+        qkv=qkvz[:, : kcfg.QKV_CHANNELS],
+        z=qkvz[:, kcfg.QKV_CHANNELS :].view(rows, kcfg.V_HEADS, kcfg.HEAD_DIM),
+        hidden=torch.randint(-1, 2, (rows, kcfg.HIDDEN), generator=g).bfloat16().to(device),
+        ba_weight=(torch.randint(-8, 9, (2 * kcfg.V_HEADS, kcfg.HIDDEN), generator=g).float() / 256).bfloat16().to(device),
+        A_log=(rn(kcfg.V_HEADS) * 0.5).to(a_dt).to(device),
+        dt_bias=(rn(kcfg.V_HEADS) * 0.5).to(dt_dt).to(device),
+        ssm_state=(rn(slots, kcfg.V_HEADS, kcfg.HEAD_DIM, kcfg.HEAD_DIM) * 0.1).to(device),
+        state_indices=idx.to(device),
+        cu_seqlens=torch.arange(0, rows + 1, tokens, dtype=torch.int32).to(device),
+        num_accepted_tokens=acc.to(device),
+        norm_weight=(1 + 0.2 * rn(kcfg.HEAD_DIM)).to(w_dt).to(device),
+        out_scale=torch.tensor([0.05]).to(device),
+        conv_state=conv.transpose(1, 2),
+        conv_weight=(rn(kcfg.QKV_CHANNELS, kcfg.CONV_WIDTH) * 0.3).bfloat16().to(device),
+    )
+    return ops
+
+
+def _conv_silu(window, weight):
+    """``window [..., C, K]`` (oldest tap first), ``weight [C, K]`` bf16 -> (the exact SiLU in FP64, its bf16): every tap product
+    rounded to bf16, the taps summed in FP32 in tap order."""
+    prod = (window.float() * weight.float()).bfloat16().float()
+    acc = prod[..., 0]
+    for j in range(1, prod.shape[-1]):
+        acc = acc + prod[..., j]
+    a = acc.double()
+    s = a / (1.0 + torch.exp(-a))
+    return s, s.float().bfloat16()
+
+
+def _windows(ops):
+    """``[(request, row slice, conv slot, source slot, window [T, C, K])]`` of every live request."""
+    requests, tokens = ops["state_indices"].shape
+    K = ops["conv_weight"].shape[1]
+    idx = ops["state_indices"].tolist()
+    acc = ops["num_accepted_tokens"].tolist()
+    out = []
+    for n in range(requests):
+        a = acc[n]
+        src = idx[n][a - 1]
+        if src <= 0 or idx[n][0] <= 0:
+            continue
+        rows = slice(n * tokens, (n + 1) * tokens)
+        seq = torch.cat([ops["conv_state"][idx[n][0]][:, a - 1 : a + K - 2], ops["qkv"][rows].T], dim=1)
+        out.append((n, rows, idx[n][0], src, seq.unfold(1, K, 1).transpose(0, 1)))
+    return out
+
+
+def _ambiguous(s):
+    bits = s.float().view(torch.int32)
+    mid = ((bits & ~0xFFFF) | 0x8000).view(torch.float32).double()
+    return (s - mid).abs() <= AMBIGUOUS_REL * s.abs()
+
+
+def condition_conv_inputs(ops, max_rounds=32):
+    """Move the newest conv input of every live (token, channel) whose exact SiLU lies within 2^-16 relative of a bf16 rounding
+    midpoint (the kernels evaluate it with ``ex2.approx``) until none is left, so the reference's bf16 q / k / v are the kernel's."""
+    moved = 0
+    for _ in range(max_rounds):
+        hits = 0
+        for _, rows, _, _, win in _windows(ops):
+            s, _ = _conv_silu(win, ops["conv_weight"])
+            bad = _ambiguous(s)
+            if bad.any():
+                x = ops["qkv"][rows]
+                v = x[bad].float()
+                x[bad] = (v + 0.0625 * v.abs().clamp_min(1.0)).bfloat16()
+                hits += int(bad.sum())
+        if hits == 0:
+            return moved
+        moved += hits
+    raise AssertionError("conv input conditioning did not converge")
+
+
+def quant_fp8(x, scale):
+    """Static per-tensor FP8: ``satfinite(x * fp32(1 / scale))`` rounded to nearest even."""
+    inv = 1.0 / scale.float().reshape(())
+    return (x.float() * inv).clamp(-FP8_MAX, FP8_MAX).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+
+
+def reference(ops, eps=1e-6):
+    """The fused chain on ``ops``: ``(out_bf16, out_fp8, ssm_state, conv_state, live_rows)``.  Rounding points as the fused kernels':
+    bf16 tap products and SiLU, the BA projection to bf16, the recurrence in FP64, the core output to bf16, the normed value to bf16."""
+    hv, dv, dk = kcfg.V_HEADS, kcfg.HEAD_DIM, kcfg.HEAD_DIM
+    hk = kcfg.K_HEADS
+    K = ops["conv_weight"].shape[1]
+    rows = ops["qkv"].shape[0]
+    dev = ops["qkv"].device
+    out = torch.zeros(rows, hv, dv, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
+    live = torch.zeros(rows, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
+    ssm = ops["ssm_state"].clone()
+    conv = ops["conv_state"].clone()
+    ba = (ops["hidden"].double() @ ops["ba_weight"].double().T).float().bfloat16().double()
+    A_log, dt_bias, w, z = ops["A_log"].double(), ops["dt_bias"].double(), ops["norm_weight"].double(), ops["z"].double()
+    idx = ops["state_indices"].tolist()
+    acc = ops["num_accepted_tokens"].tolist()
+    for n, rows_n, cslot, src, win in _windows(ops):
+        _, x = _conv_silu(win, ops["conv_weight"])
+        x = x.double()
+        a = acc[n]
+        tokens = win.shape[0]
+        old = ops["conv_state"][cslot]
+        conv[cslot] = torch.cat([old[:, a : a + K - 2], ops["qkv"][rows_n].T], dim=1)
+        h = ops["ssm_state"][src].double()
+        for t in range(tokens):
+            r = rows_n.start + t
+            q = x[t, : hk * dk].view(hk, dk)
+            k = x[t, hk * dk : 2 * hk * dk].view(hk, dk)
+            v = x[t, 2 * hk * dk :].view(hv, dv)
+            q = q / (q.square().sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6).sqrt() * dk**-0.5
+            k = k / (k.square().sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6).sqrt()
+            q = q.repeat_interleave(hv // hk, 0)
+            k = k.repeat_interleave(hv // hk, 0)
+            gate = -A_log.exp() * torch.nn.functional.softplus(ba[r, hv:] + dt_bias)
+            beta = torch.sigmoid(ba[r, :hv])
+            h = h * gate.exp()[:, None, None]
+            innov = (v - (h * k[:, None, :]).sum(-1)) * beta[:, None]
+            h = h + innov[:, :, None] * k[:, None, :]
+            if idx[n][t] > 0:
+                ssm[idx[n][t]] = h.float()
+            core = (h * q[:, None, :]).sum(-1).float().bfloat16().double()
+            inv = torch.rsqrt(core.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+            zr = z[r]
+            out[r] = (core * inv * w * zr * torch.sigmoid(zr)).float().bfloat16()
+            live[r] = True
+    return out, quant_fp8(out, ops["out_scale"]), ssm, conv, live
+
+
+def pools_before(ops):
+    """Clones of the two pools the kernel updates in place (the reference starts from them; the kernel's results are compared)."""
+    return ops["ssm_state"].clone(), ops["conv_state"].clone()
+
+
+def check_against_reference(ops, q, out, ssm0, conv0, eps=1e-6):
+    """The reference verify kernel's acceptance bars against the torch reference: ``ssm0`` / ``conv0`` are the pools BEFORE the launch
+    (the reference runs on them), ``ops`` holds the kernel's updated pools."""
+    ssm, conv = ops["ssm_state"], ops["conv_state"]
+    ref_out, ref_q, ref_ssm, ref_conv, live = reference(dict(ops, ssm_state=ssm0, conv_state=conv0), eps)
+    diff = (out.float() - ref_out.float()).abs()
+    bad = diff > ref_out.float().abs() * 2**-6 + 1e-3
+    assert not bad.any(), (int(bad.sum()), float(diff.max()))
+    same = (q[live].view(torch.uint8) == ref_q[live].view(torch.uint8)).float().mean()
+    assert float(same) > 0.999, float(same)
+    assert torch.equal(
+        q.view(torch.uint8), quant_fp8(out, ops["out_scale"]).view(torch.uint8)
+    ), "fp8 is the static quantization of the kernel's own bf16 output"
+    assert not q[~live].view(torch.uint8).any() and not out[~live].any(), "padding rows are zero"
+    assert torch.equal(conv, ref_conv), "the conv pool shifts bitwise"
+    idx = ops["state_indices"]
+    written = torch.zeros(ssm.shape[0], dtype=torch.bool, device=ssm.device)
+    for n, _, _, _, _ in _windows(ops):
+        for t in range(idx.shape[1]):
+            if int(idx[n, t]) > 0:
+                written[int(idx[n, t])] = True
+    assert torch.equal(ssm[~written], ssm0[~written]), "untouched slots (padding requests, skipped writes, unreferenced) stay"
+    err = float((ssm[written] - ref_ssm[written]).abs().max()) if written.any() else 0.0
+    assert err < 1e-4, err
+
